words.enDefinition: A planned benchmark fixed before the activity and used later to compare expected and actual results.

examples.en: The training workshop worked to a predetermined standard because actual time was unknown when it priced the exercise.
examples.zh: 培训工场按「预先设定的标准」来核算练习价格，因为当时还不知道实际耗时。

examples.en: Our spreadsheet compared the time recorded for every kit with the same predetermined standard throughout the trial.
examples.zh: 整个试验过程中，表格都用同一个「预先设定的标准」核对各套件的记录工时。

collocations: compare actual use with a predetermined standard

words.enDefinition: An existing duty resulting from past events that the entity has no practical ability to avoid.

examples.en: The example identified a present obligation because the goods had already been sold with a repair guarantee.
examples.zh: 由于商品已经售出并附有维修保证，例题认定存在一项「现时义务」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what evidence showed that the company had a present obligation at year end.
examples.zh: 老师问，有什么证据表明该公司年末已存在「现时义务」。

collocations: assess whether a present obligation exists

words.enDefinition: The part of a change in revenue or cost attributed to a difference in the price per unit.

examples.en: The worksheet isolated the price effect by keeping the number of tickets sold the same in both columns.
examples.zh: 练习表把两列售出的票数保持一致，以单独量化「价格效应」。

examples.en: We found a strong price effect after the supplier charged more for an otherwise unchanged order.
examples.zh: 其他订单条件都没变，供应商涨价后，我们观察到明显的「价格效应」。

collocations: separate the price effect from changes in volume

words.enDefinition: separating changes attributable to prices, quantities, and the sales mix

examples.en: The class used price-volume-mix analysis to understand why revenue rose while total units sold barely changed.
examples.zh: 同学们用「价格销量组合分析」理解为什么总销量变化很小，收入却上升了。

examples.en: We used price-volume-mix analysis after noticing that the sample sold more of its higher-priced products.
examples.zh: 我们发现样本中单价较高的产品卖得更多，于是做了「价格销量组合分析」。

words.enDefinition: In fair value measurement, the accessible market with the greatest volume and activity for the item.

examples.en: We identified the principal market by checking which accessible marketplace had the highest trading activity for the asset.
examples.zh: 我们核查哪个可进入的市场对该资产的交易最活跃，以确定「主要市场」。

examples.en: The fair value example used the principal market even though another accessible market offered a better price.
examples.zh: 公允价值例题采用「主要市场」，尽管另一个可进入的市场报价更有利。

collocations: observe prices in the principal market
lack access to the principal market

words.enDefinition: cash payments that reduce the principal balance owed on borrowings

examples.en: The example placed principal repayments of borrowings on a line separate from the interest payments shown.
examples.zh: 示例把「偿还借款本金的款项」和利息付款分开列示。

examples.en: We added up principal repayments of borrowings before comparing the figures with the year-end debt balances.
examples.zh: 我们先合计「偿还借款本金的款项」，再把结果与年末债务余额作比较。

words.zhGloss: 很可能发生的资源流出
words.enDefinition: In IAS 37, a transfer of resources that is more likely to occur than not as an obligation is settled.
acceptedZhAnswers: 很可能发生的资源流出

examples.en: The case described a probable outflow of resources after the company assessed outstanding claims from the warranty programme.
examples.zh: 公司评估保修计划中尚未处理的索赔后，例题描述了「很可能发生的资源流出」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what evidence supported a probable outflow of resources in the sample financial statements.
examples.zh: 老师问，哪些证据支持示例财务报表所称「很可能发生的资源流出」。

collocations: assess a probable outflow of resources
evidence of a probable outflow of resources
identify a probable outflow of resources

words.enDefinition: cash received from obtaining debt financing during the reporting period

examples.en: The company presented proceeds from borrowings when it drew on a loan to fund the expansion.
examples.zh: 公司为扩张而提款时，将这笔钱列为「收到的借款款项」。

examples.en: We traced proceeds from borrowings to the two bank deposits shown in the debt reconciliation schedule.
examples.zh: 我们在债务调节表上找到了与「收到的借款款项」对应的两笔银行入账。

words.zhGloss: 发行债务票据收到的款项
words.enDefinition: cash received from investors or other lenders when an entity issues debt instruments called notes
acceptedZhAnswers: 发行债务票据收到的款项

examples.en: The company received proceeds from issue of notes after it placed the debt with institutional investors.
examples.zh: 公司将债务票据配售给机构投资者后，收到了「发行债务票据收到的款项」。

examples.en: In the example, proceeds from issue of notes appeared below the financing cash flows from issuing shares.
examples.zh: 示例中，「发行债务票据收到的款项」列在发行股份取得的筹资现金流之后。

collocations: report proceeds from issue of notes
disclose proceeds from issue of notes
trace proceeds from issue of notes

words.expression: proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment
words.lemma: proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment
words.zhGloss: 出售不动产、厂房和设备收到的款项
words.enDefinition: cash received from selling tangible long-term assets that were held for use in the business
acceptedZhAnswers: 出售不动产、厂房和设备收到的款项
acceptedEnVariants: proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment

examples.en: The company disclosed proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment after selling a manufacturing site.
examples.zh: 公司卖掉一处制造厂区后，披露了「出售不动产、厂房和设备收到的款项」。

examples.en: We reconciled proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment with the cash received for two vehicles.
examples.zh: 我们用出售两辆车收到的现金核对了「出售不动产、厂房和设备收到的款项」。

collocations: report proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment
disclose proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment
cash proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment

words.enDefinition: a system that accumulates costs by process or department and averages them over similar units of output

examples.en: We used process costing because the workshop produced identical notebooks in a continuous series of steps.
examples.zh: 工作室连续经过一系列步骤生产相同的笔记本，我们用的是「分步成本法」。

examples.en: The class compared process costing for the standard badges with separate costing for custom orders.
examples.zh: 课堂比较了标准徽章用的「分步成本法」与定制订单单独核算的做法。

words.enDefinition: a reduction in the quantity of usable output during a production process

examples.en: The example recorded process loss when some paper was trimmed away while making the notebooks.
examples.zh: 制作笔记本时裁掉了部分纸张，案例中记为「制程损耗」。

examples.en: The lecturer separated expected process loss from the much larger loss caused by the equipment fault.
examples.zh: 讲师把预期的「制程损耗」与设备故障造成的更大损失分开。

words.enDefinition: an activity supporting a particular product line regardless of the number of units or batches made

examples.en: Maintaining the booklet's design files was a product-level activity even when nothing was being printed.
examples.zh: 即使没在印刷，维护那本小册子的设计文件也是「产品级作业」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether revising the instructions for one kit was a product-level activity instead.
examples.zh: 导师问，修订一种套件的说明书是否应算「产品级作业」。

words.enDefinition: a process costing report summarising production quantities, equivalent units and costs assigned during a period

examples.en: The production cost report showed separate amounts for completed output and the units still in process.
examples.zh: 「生产成本报告」分别列出了完工产量和仍在加工的单位数对应的金额。

examples.en: Our instructor asked us to prepare a production cost report for the final assembly department.
examples.zh: 老师请我们给最后一道组装部门编制「生产成本报告」。

collocations: production cost report for a department

words.enDefinition: an instruction authorising the production of a specified quantity of an item or batch

examples.en: The production order authorised fifty notebooks for the department's orientation event at the end of August.
examples.zh: 「生产工单」批准为系里八月底举办的迎新活动生产五十本笔记本。

examples.en: The workshop checked the production order before cutting the materials for the next batch.
examples.zh: 工作室先核查了「生产工单」，才裁切下一批的材料。

words.enDefinition: a factor that explains a change or difference in profitability

examples.en: Lower delivery costs were the main profitability driver in the fictional retailer's second year.
examples.zh: 配送成本下降是虚构零售商第二年的主要「盈利驱动因素」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which profitability driver mattered most after removing the effect of currency changes.
examples.zh: 导师问，剔除汇率变动的影响后，哪个「盈利驱动因素」最重要。

words.enDefinition: Applying a changed policy from the change date or recognising an estimate change in affected current and later periods.

examples.en: The class used prospective application for the new useful life estimate after reviewing the machine's condition.
examples.zh: 看过机器状态后，同学们对新的使用寿命估计采用「未来适用法」。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed prospective application by revising depreciation from the estimate change date and leaving earlier figures unchanged.
examples.zh: 练习表演示了「未来适用法」，从估计变更之日起调整折旧，保留之前期间的数字。

collocations: contrast prospective application with retrospective application
explain prospective application of an estimate change

words.enDefinition: Removal of all or part of a provision when the amount is no longer needed.

examples.en: The worksheet showed a provision reversal after evidence indicated that some of the expected claims would not arise.
examples.zh: 证据显示一些原先预计的索赔不会发生后，练习表列出了一项「预计负债转回」。

examples.en: Our tutor separated a provision reversal from using the balance to cover repairs the company had paid for.
examples.zh: 老师把「预计负债转回」同以余额冲抵公司已支付的维修费用区分开。

collocations: show a provision reversal in the notes

words.enDefinition: A reconciliation showing changes from the opening to the closing balances of a class of provisions.

examples.en: The provision rollforward showed new warranty costs, amounts used and the balance at the end of the year.
examples.zh: 「预计负债余额变动表」列明了保修预计负债的新增金额、使用额和年末余额。

examples.en: We used the provision rollforward to identify why the closing liability was higher despite fewer repair claims.
examples.zh: 我们用「预计负债余额变动表」查明为什么维修索赔减少了，期末负债却增加了。

collocations: list amounts used in a provision rollforward

words.enDefinition: Expenditure incurred and charged against a previously recorded provision for the same obligation.

examples.en: The provision utilisation line showed the repair costs charged against the opening balance during the period.
examples.zh: 「预计负债使用额」一行列出了本期冲减期初余额的维修费用。

examples.en: Our group compared provision utilisation with the costs estimated when the defective products were originally sold.
examples.zh: 我们组把「预计负债使用额」与有缺陷的商品原先售出时估计的成本作比较。

collocations: show provision utilisation in a reconciliation

words.enDefinition: acquisition of holdings such as shares or debt securities for investment purposes

examples.en: The sample statement showed the purchase of investments separately from amounts paid for machinery in the factory.
examples.zh: 示例报表把「购买投资资产」与购买厂内机器所支付的金额分开列报。

examples.en: We treated the purchase of investments as an investing outflow in the example involving a manufacturing company.
examples.zh: 在一家制造公司的示例里，我们把「购买投资资产」作为投资现金流出。

collocations: cash paid for the purchase of investments

words.expression: purchase of property, plant and equipment
words.lemma: purchase of property, plant and equipment
words.zhGloss: 购建不动产、厂房和设备
words.enDefinition: the acquisition of tangible long-term operating assets, shown as an investing outflow when cash is paid
acceptedZhAnswers: 购建不动产、厂房和设备
acceptedEnVariants: purchase of property, plant and equipment

examples.en: The investing section listed purchase of property, plant and equipment after the proceeds from an old vehicle.
examples.zh: 投资部分在处置旧车收到的款项后列报「购建不动产、厂房和设备」。

examples.en: We traced cash paid for the purchase of property, plant and equipment to the capital expenditure schedule.
examples.zh: 我们在资本支出附表中追溯了「购建不动产、厂房和设备」支付的现金。

collocations: cash paid for the purchase of property, plant and equipment
report the purchase of property, plant and equipment
disclose the purchase of property, plant and equipment

words.enDefinition: assigning a shared cost in proportion to quantities such as the number of units or transactions

examples.en: The retail team used quantity-based allocation to divide sorting costs among the three types of kits.
examples.zh: 零售团队采用「按数量分摊」的办法，在三种套件之间分配分拣费用。

examples.en: We compared quantity-based allocation with an approach based on how long each repair took to finish.
examples.zh: 我们把「按数量分摊」与按各次维修所耗时间进行的分配作了比较。

words.enDefinition: breaking a ratio into components to explain its movement

examples.en: The tutor used ratio decomposition to separate asset use from profitability in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 导师用「比率拆解」区分课堂案例中资产使用与盈利能力的影响。

examples.en: Our ratio decomposition showed which input explained most of the change in the reported measure.
examples.zh: 我们的「比率拆解」显示，哪个输入解释了报告指标变动的大部分。

words.enDefinition: a reconciliation of opening raw materials, additions, materials issued and ending raw material inventory

examples.en: The raw materials rollforward showed that the workshop issued more paper than it purchased in April.
examples.zh: 「原材料余额变动表」显示，四月工作室领用的纸超过购入量。

examples.en: I compared the raw materials rollforward with the records from the store before preparing my report.
examples.zh: 我先把「原材料余额变动表」与库房记录比对，再编制报告。

words.enDefinition: a method allocating support department costs while accounting for services provided to one another

examples.en: The exercise used the reciprocal allocation method because two support departments regularly helped each other.
examples.zh: 两个辅助部门经常互相协助，练习因此使用了「交互分配法」。

examples.en: Our lecturer used simultaneous equations to demonstrate the reciprocal allocation method in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 讲师用联立方程演示了课堂案例里的「交互分配法」。

collocations: calculate costs with the reciprocal allocation method

words.enDefinition: prior-period amounts regrouped to match a different presentation

examples.en: The reclassified comparatives moved delivery charges into a separate row without changing the total.
examples.zh: 「重新分类的比较数据」把配送费移到单独一行，总额保持不变。

examples.en: We checked whether last year's sales appeared in the reclassified comparatives under the same segment headings.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「重新分类的比较数据」是否在同样的分部标题下列示去年销售额。

words.enDefinition: Under IAS 37, to record a present obligation when an outflow is probable and a reliable estimate is possible.

examples.en: The class decided to recognise a provision after estimating the probable costs of restoring the leased site.
examples.zh: 同学们估算了很可能发生的租用场地恢复成本后，决定「确认预计负债」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what evidence the company needed before it could recognise a provision for the repair claims.
examples.zh: 老师问，公司需要哪些证据，才能就维修索赔「确认预计负债」。

collocations: recognise a provision at year end
assess whether to recognise a provision

words.enDefinition: The conditions for recording an item in the financial statements under the relevant accounting framework.

examples.en: The class checked the recognition criteria before deciding whether to include the equipment in the balance sheet.
examples.zh: 全班先核对「确认条件」，再决定是否把设备列入资产负债表。

examples.en: We read the FASB framework's recognition criteria before checking whether the amount could be measured faithfully.
examples.zh: 我们先读了 FASB 概念框架的「确认条件」，再核查金额能否得到如实计量。

collocations: review the recognition criteria for an asset

words.zhGloss: 核对并解释实际与预算的差额
words.enDefinition: To account for the changes that explain the difference between a budgeted figure and the actual result.
acceptedZhAnswers: 核对并解释实际与预算的差额

examples.en: We had to reconcile actual to budget before presenting the print room's monthly figures to our tutor.
examples.zh: 向老师汇报印刷室的月度数字前，我们得「核对并解释实际与预算的差额」。

examples.en: To reconcile actual to budget, we listed each price change and each shift in production volume.
examples.zh: 为了「核对并解释实际与预算的差额」，我们列出了每次价格变动和每次产量变化。

collocations: reconcile actual to budget by category
reconcile actual to budget each month
reconcile actual to budget using a variance bridge

words.enDefinition: an accompanying explanation of how values were reconciled

examples.en: The reconciliation note explained why one figure in the original report had been grouped differently.
examples.zh: 「指标调节说明」解释了原报告中的一项数字为什么采用不同分组。

examples.en: We checked the reconciliation note for explanations of the adjustments listed in the accompanying table.
examples.zh: 我们查看「指标调节说明」，找出它对附表中各项调整的解释。

collocations: a reconciliation note explaining the differences

words.expression: reconciliation of profit to operating cash flow
words.lemma: reconciliation of profit to operating cash flow
words.zhGloss: 利润与经营现金流调节
words.enDefinition: an explanation of the differences between accrued profit and cash flows from operations
acceptedZhAnswers: 利润与经营现金流调节
acceptedEnVariants: reconciliation of profit to operating cash flow

examples.en: The lender reviewed the reconciliation of profit to operating cash flow alongside the notes on receivables.
examples.zh: 贷款机构把「利润与经营现金流调节」和应收账款附注放在一起看。

examples.en: We completed the reconciliation of profit to operating cash flow after deducting the gain on the equipment sale.
examples.zh: 扣除出售设备的利得后，我们完成了「利润与经营现金流调节」。

collocations: prepare a reconciliation of profit to operating cash flow
review the reconciliation of profit to operating cash flow
publish a reconciliation of profit to operating cash flow

words.enDefinition: a table connecting two amounts by listing the intervening differences

examples.en: The reconciliation table listed each adjustment between the reported and adjusted figures in the sample.
examples.zh: 「指标调节表」列出了样本列报数据和调整后数据之间的每项调整。

examples.en: Our group checked whether the reconciliation table added up to the total in the presentation.
examples.zh: 小组核对了「指标调节表」的合计是否等于展示材料中的总额。

words.enDefinition: an amount listed to explain part of a difference between measures

examples.en: The sample table labelled each reconciling item before showing the adjusted total on the last line.
examples.zh: 样本表格先为各个「调节项目」加上标签，再在最后一行列出调整后总额。

examples.en: We checked whether the largest reconciling item also appeared in the notes to the published accounts.
examples.zh: 我们核对了金额最大的「调节项目」是否也出现在已发布报表的附注中。

collocations: the tax effect of a reconciling item

words.enDefinition: A fair value measurement required or permitted in the statement of financial position at each reporting period end.

examples.en: The exercise showed a recurring fair value measurement for property remeasured at the end of each year.
examples.zh: 例题中的物业每年末都重新计量，体现了「经常性公允价值计量」。

examples.en: The table identified the hierarchy level for each recurring fair value measurement shown in the sample statements.
examples.zh: 表格标明了示例报表中每项「经常性公允价值计量」所属的层次。

collocations: identify a recurring fair value measurement
disclose a recurring fair value measurement
classify a recurring fair value measurement within the hierarchy

words.enDefinition: The benefit obtainable by shifting an existing resource to another use

examples.en: The scenario calculated redeployment value for a machine that could serve another department.
examples.zh: 案例为可以调给另一个部门的机器计算了「调作他用的价值」。

examples.en: We discussed redeployment value before deciding what to include in the cost comparison.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论「调作他用的价值」，再决定成本比较纳入哪些项目。

collocations: compare redeployment value with disposal proceeds

words.enDefinition: Under IAS 37, a separately recognised right to recover expenditure when reimbursement is virtually certain if the obligation is settled.

examples.en: The exercise showed the reimbursement asset separately because an insurer would cover part of the settlement.
examples.zh: 练习把「补偿资产」单独列出，因为保险方会承担部分和解款。

examples.en: We compared the recognised reimbursement asset with the expense the example company expected to recover.
examples.zh: 我们对比了已确认的「补偿资产」和示例公司预期可以收回的费用。

words.enDefinition: A person or entity with a relationship to the reporting entity that qualifies under the applicable reporting rules.

examples.en: The reporting exercise identified the parent company as a related party before reviewing any outstanding balances.
examples.zh: 报表练习先把母公司确定为「关联方」，再核查未结余额。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what information showed that the supplier qualified as a related party under IAS 24.
examples.zh: 老师问，有什么信息表明供应商在 IAS 24 下属于「关联方」。

collocations: determine whether an entity is a related party
a transaction with a related party

words.enDefinition: An amount still due to or from a related party at a specified date.

examples.en: The sample report disclosed a related party balance after the subsidiary bought equipment from its parent on credit.
examples.zh: 子公司向母公司赊购设备后，示例报告披露了一笔「关联方往来余额」。

examples.en: We traced the related party balance in the note to the year-end receivable in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把附注里的「关联方往来余额」追溯到练习表上的年末应收款。

collocations: explain the terms of a related party balance

words.enDefinition: Commitments to transfer resources or provide services under arrangements involving a related party.

examples.en: The note on related party commitments described an agreement to buy services from an entity under common control.
examples.zh: 「关联方承诺事项」附注说明了从一家同受控制的主体购买服务的协议。

examples.en: Our group listed related party commitments separately from invoices already included in the example's reported balances.
examples.zh: 我们组单独列出「关联方承诺事项」，与已计入例题所列余额的发票分开。

collocations: describe the terms of related party commitments

words.enDefinition: A transfer of resources, services or obligations between related parties, whether or not any amount is charged.

examples.en: The class identified a related party transaction when the parent supplied office space to its subsidiary without charge.
examples.zh: 母公司免费向子公司提供办公场地，同学们将其识别为一项「关联方交易」。

examples.en: The notes explained the purpose of the related party transaction and how it affected expenses for the year.
examples.zh: 附注解释了「关联方交易」的目的和它对当年费用的影响。

words.enDefinition: The span of time over which costs and benefits are compared

examples.en: The relevant time horizon ended before the lease could be renegotiated in our case.
examples.zh: 在案例中，租约可以重新商谈之前，「相关决策期间」就结束了。

examples.en: We agreed on a relevant time horizon before deciding which costs could change.
examples.zh: 我们先确定「相关决策期间」，再判断哪些成本可能变动。

collocations: changes in the relevant time horizon

words.enDefinition: Contractual promises the entity has yet to satisfy, including any unsatisfied portions of partly fulfilled promises.

examples.en: The notes identified the remaining performance obligations for service to be delivered after the end of the year.
examples.zh: 附注列出了年末之后还需交付的服务所对应的「剩余履约义务」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how much of the contract price was allocated to remaining performance obligations in the example.
examples.zh: 老师问，例题中合同价格有多少分配给了「剩余履约义务」。

collocations: allocate consideration to remaining performance obligations
describe the timing of remaining performance obligations

words.enDefinition: Determining a revised amount for an item that has already been recognised.

examples.en: The change in exchange rates led to remeasurement of the foreign currency payable in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 汇率变动后，我们在练习表里对外币应付款进行了「重新计量」。

examples.en: Our example showed a gain on remeasurement after the revised estimate reduced the amount of the liability.
examples.zh: 例题中，修订后的估计使负债金额减少，因「重新计量」而产生了利得。

words.enDefinition: In contingency reporting, a very low likelihood that settling a matter will require a transfer of economic resources.

examples.en: The tutor asked what evidence supported a remote possibility of outflow for the disputed expense in the case.
examples.zh: 老师问，哪些证据支持这样的判断：例题中的争议费用引起「资源流出可能性极小」。

examples.en: The notes exercise treated a remote possibility of outflow differently from a payment considered more likely.
examples.zh: 附注练习对「资源流出可能性极小」和更可能发生付款的情况作了不同处理。

collocations: assess a remote possibility of outflow
a remote possibility of outflow of resources
conclude there is a remote possibility of outflow

words.enDefinition: the earnings figure shown in the published statements

examples.en: The group compared reported earnings with a separate measure used in the fictional company's presentation.
examples.zh: 小组将「列报盈利」与虚构公司展示材料中的另一项指标作了比较。

examples.en: We checked whether the headline amount matched reported earnings in the sample income statement.
examples.zh: 我们核对了标题金额是否与样本利润表中的「列报盈利」一致。

words.enDefinition: growth calculated from amounts as published in the reports

examples.en: The sample's reported growth included the sales of a business acquired during the year.
examples.zh: 样本的「报告口径增长」包含当年新收购业务带来的销售额。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why reported growth could differ from a constant-currency calculation for the period.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「报告口径增长」可能与该期间按固定汇率口径计算的增幅不同。

collocations: reconcile reported growth to an adjusted figure

words.enDefinition: The date as of which the end-of-period financial position is presented.

examples.en: The tutor asked what information about the damaged inventory was available at the reporting date.
examples.zh: 老师问，截至「报告期末日」可以获得哪些有关受损存货的信息。

examples.en: We marked the reporting date on the timeline before adding the later events discussed in the case.
examples.zh: 我们先在时间线上标出「报告期末日」，再加入例题讨论的后续事项。

words.enDefinition: a measure used to assign the cost of a resource to the activities that use it

examples.en: We used floor space as the resource driver for assigning rent to several different workshop activities.
examples.zh: 我们采用占用面积作为「资源动因」，把租金分配给几项不同的工作室作业。

examples.en: The tutor distinguished a resource driver from the measure used to assign activity costs to products.
examples.zh: 导师把「资源动因」与将作业成本分配给产品时使用的衡量标准区分开。

collocations: allocate costs using a resource driver

words.enDefinition: Using one available resource in place of another to perform work

examples.en: The example explored resource substitution by shifting finishing work onto another machine.
examples.zh: 示例通过把收尾工序移到另一台机器上，讨论了「资源替换」。

examples.en: We logged the time changes caused by resource substitution on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习表上记录了「资源替换」造成的工时变化。

collocations: assess the cost of resource substitution

words.enDefinition: An accounting approach that reports results by organisational unit and links measures to what its manager can influence.

examples.en: Our course used responsibility accounting to decide which results belonged in each workshop manager's monthly report.
examples.zh: 课程用「责任会计」确定各工场经理的月度报告应涵盖哪些经营结果。

examples.en: The responsibility accounting exercise gave the library team control over supplies while central office managed rent.
examples.zh: 「责任会计」练习中，图书馆团队负责物资开支，总部负责租金。

collocations: evaluate a unit through responsibility accounting

words.enDefinition: An organisational unit whose manager is accountable for specified results and has authority over decisions affecting those results.

examples.en: The campus print room became a responsibility centre with its own budget and a named manager.
examples.zh: 校园印刷室成了「责任中心」，有自己的预算，也指定了一名经理负责。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what decisions the manager of each responsibility centre could actually make in the case.
examples.zh: 老师问，案例中每个「责任中心」的经理实际能做哪些决定。

collocations: assign a manager to a responsibility centre

words.enDefinition: An internal report showing the performance measures and budget differences assigned to a particular manager or responsibility centre.

examples.en: The responsibility report separated the maintenance team's supply costs from building charges set by central office.
examples.zh: 「责任会计报告」把维修团队领用物资的成本和总部定下的楼宇费用分开。

examples.en: In our case, each manager received a responsibility report for the department they could actually influence.
examples.zh: 案例中，每位经理收到的「责任会计报告」都对应自己实际有权管理的部门。

collocations: show controllable costs in the responsibility report

words.enDefinition: prior-period amounts presented again after a correction or other restatement

examples.en: The worksheet showed restated comparatives after the fictional company corrected a prior-year reporting error.
examples.zh: 虚构公司更正上期报告错误后，练习表列出了「重述后比较数据」。

examples.en: We used the restated comparatives for the trend chart and kept the original version for reference.
examples.zh: 我们的趋势图采用「重述后比较数据」，原始版本则保留以供查阅。

words.enDefinition: cash that cannot be freely used because of a legal, contractual or similar restriction

examples.en: The company disclosed restricted cash held in a separate account to cover payments under an earlier agreement.
examples.zh: 公司披露了单独账户中的「受限现金」，用以履行先前协议约定的付款。

examples.en: We read the note on restricted cash to find when the balance would become available for general use.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「受限现金」附注，以了解该余额何时能自由使用。

words.enDefinition: investments of a cash-equivalent nature whose use is restricted

examples.en: The US GAAP statement included unrestricted cash and restricted cash equivalents in both reported cash totals.
examples.zh: 这份按美国公认会计原则编制的报表在期初和期末现金合计中都计入了非受限现金和「受限现金等价物」。

examples.en: We checked which short-term holdings the policy identified as restricted cash equivalents in the balance sheet note.
examples.zh: 我们查看资产负债表附注，确认按该政策哪些短期投资属于「受限现金等价物」。

words.enDefinition: under US GAAP, connecting cash flow statement totals to the balance sheet lines containing cash, cash equivalents and their restricted counterparts

examples.en: The US GAAP example's restricted cash reconciliation linked the cash flow total to two balance sheet lines.
examples.zh: 在美国公认会计原则的示例中，报表通过「受限现金调节」将现金流量表的现金合计与资产负债表上的两个项目对应起来。

examples.en: We checked the restricted cash reconciliation against each balance sheet line listed in the example note.
examples.zh: 我们对照示例附注列出的资产负债表各项目核对了「受限现金调节」。

words.enDefinition: a condition that limits where, when or for what purpose cash can be spent or transferred

examples.en: The company explained a restriction on use of cash imposed by the terms of a funding agreement.
examples.zh: 公司说明了资金协议条款规定的一项「现金使用限制」。

examples.en: Under IAS 7, a restriction on use of cash did not prevent withdrawal of this deposit on demand.
examples.zh: 按照 IAS 7，这项「现金使用限制」未妨碍这笔存款随时提取。

collocations: disclose a restriction on use of cash
identify a restriction on use of cash
lift a restriction on use of cash

words.enDefinition: an expense associated with reorganising part of an entity

examples.en: The sample showed a restructuring charge after the fictional retailer announced plans to combine two branches.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商宣布计划合并两家分店后，样本列出一笔「重组费用」。

examples.en: We checked whether another restructuring charge appeared in the report for the preceding year.
examples.zh: 我们核对了上一年的报告是否也出现另一笔「重组费用」。

collocations: a restructuring charge in operating expenses

words.enDefinition: An IAS 37 provision for qualifying direct restructuring expenditure when a present obligation to restructure exists.

examples.en: The tutor asked which direct costs belonged in the restructuring provision after reading the published plan.
examples.zh: 阅读已公布的方案后，老师问，哪些直接支出应计入「重组预计负债」。

examples.en: Our example treated announcement of the detailed closure plan as evidence in assessing a restructuring provision.
examples.zh: 例题把宣布详细关停计划作为评估「重组预计负债」的一项证据。

collocations: disclose the basis of a restructuring provision

words.enDefinition: Shared costs that continue after a project or segment is dropped

examples.en: The closure scenario listed retained common costs because the lease still covered both units.
examples.zh: 租约仍覆盖两个单位，所以关闭情景列出了「仍需承担的共同成本」。

examples.en: We moved retained common costs out of the savings column on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「仍需承担的共同成本」从练习表中的节省额一栏移了出去。

words.enDefinition: Applying a new accounting policy to past transactions and events as if it had always been used.

examples.en: In the case, retrospective application meant using the new policy for transactions in the comparative year.
examples.zh: 在例题中，「追溯应用」指把新政策用到比较年度的交易上。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how retrospective application of the new policy affected the earliest opening equity balance.
examples.zh: 老师演示了新政策的「追溯应用」如何影响最早列报期的期初权益余额。

collocations: explain retrospective application of a policy

words.enDefinition: Correcting prior-period financial information as if the error had never occurred.

examples.en: The retrospective restatement corrected the comparative figures after we found a material error in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在练习表里发现重大差错后，我们用「追溯重述」更正了比较数据。

examples.en: Our tutor used retrospective restatement to illustrate how a misclassified expense affected the previous year's figures.
examples.zh: 老师用「追溯重述」说明误分类的费用怎样影响上一年的数据。

collocations: explain the effect of retrospective restatement
require retrospective restatement of comparative figures

words.zhGloss: 向所有者返还投入资本
words.enDefinition: a distribution of previously contributed capital back to the owners of an entity
acceptedZhAnswers: 向所有者返还投入资本

examples.en: The fictional company reported a return of capital to owners after the shareholders approved a capital reduction.
examples.zh: 股东批准减资后，这家虚构公司报告了「向所有者返还投入资本」。

examples.en: We distinguished a return of capital to owners from a distribution of accumulated earnings in the example.
examples.zh: 我们在示例中区分了「向所有者返还投入资本」与分配累积盈利。

collocations: report a return of capital to owners
approve a return of capital to owners
disclose a return of capital to owners

words.enDefinition: after-tax operating profit divided by average net operating assets

examples.en: We compared return on net operating assets after separating the sample companies' operating and financing balances.
examples.zh: 我们将样本公司的经营性余额和融资性余额分开后，比较了「净经营资产收益率」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how a smaller asset base affected the return on net operating assets.
examples.zh: 导师问，资产基数减少会怎样影响「净经营资产收益率」。

collocations: calculate return on net operating assets
compare return on net operating assets
a higher return on net operating assets

words.enDefinition: Throughput contribution divided by each product's time on the constrained resource

examples.en: The return per factory hour was highest for the item yielding the most contribution per milling hour.
examples.zh: 每铣削工时产出贡献最高的商品，具有最高的「单位瓶颈工时产出」。

examples.en: We divided throughput by bottleneck time to find return per factory hour for each product.
examples.zh: 我们用产出贡献除以瓶颈工时，算出各产品的「单位瓶颈工时产出」。

collocations: rank products by return per factory hour

words.enDefinition: a breakdown connecting revenue levels through the factors that changed them

examples.en: The revenue bridge explained the increase from last year's figure to the current reported amount.
examples.zh: 「收入变动桥接表」解释了收入为何从上年数字增长到当前报告金额。

examples.en: Our worksheet used a revenue bridge to separate price increases and the contribution of a new branch.
examples.zh: 练习表用「收入变动桥接表」分别列出提价和新分店的贡献。

collocations: drivers shown in the revenue bridge

words.enDefinition: A responsibility centre whose manager is assessed mainly on revenue and has primary authority over generating it.

examples.en: The booking desk was a revenue centre because its manager was evaluated on the revenue from ticket sales.
examples.zh: 售票处经理的考核指标是门票收入，因此售票处属于「收入中心」。

examples.en: Our tutor treated the campus studio's sales team as a revenue centre for the reporting exercise.
examples.zh: 老师在报告练习中把校园工作室的销售团队视作「收入中心」。

collocations: evaluate a revenue centre on sales
classify a unit as a revenue centre

words.enDefinition: breaking reported revenue into categories that show how economic factors affect the nature, amount, timing or uncertainty of revenue and cash flows

examples.en: The notes provided revenue disaggregation by product line so readers could see which sales categories were growing.
examples.zh: 附注按产品线进行「收入分拆披露」，让读者看到哪些销售类别在增长。

examples.en: Our group compared revenue disaggregation by location with a table split by the timing of delivery.
examples.zh: 我们组把按地点做的「收入分拆披露」和按交付时点划分的表格作了比较。

collocations: discuss the basis for revenue disaggregation

words.enDefinition: the durability and reliability of reported revenue sources

examples.en: The class discussed revenue quality after discovering that most growth came from a single temporary contract.
examples.zh: 发现大部分增长来自一份临时合同后，同学们讨论了「收入质量」。

examples.en: Our report linked revenue quality to repeat demand and actual collections in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 报告把「收入质量」与虚构案例中的重复需求和实际收款联系起来。

words.enDefinition: An updated budget reflecting changes to its assumptions, figures, or approved plans after it was first prepared.

examples.en: The revised budget allowed for fewer event sessions after the hall became unavailable on Fridays.
examples.zh: 大厅周五无法使用后，「修订后的预算」按更少的活动场次编制。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how a revised budget could account for a known change in fuel costs.
examples.zh: 老师演示了「修订后的预算」可以怎样纳入已知的燃料费用变化。

collocations: compare figures with the revised budget

words.enDefinition: A cost, quantity, or time standard updated to reflect new information or changed conditions.

examples.en: In the case, the revised standard allowed for a lasting increase in the cost of recycled paper.
examples.zh: 案例中的「修订后的标准」考虑了再生纸成本的持续上涨。

examples.en: We compared actual hours with the revised standard after learning that the new design required another step.
examples.zh: 得知新设计多了一个步骤后，我们用实际工时与「修订后的标准」比较。

collocations: compare actual results with the revised standard
value the planning variance against a revised standard

words.enDefinition: the risk that estimation uncertainty will cause a significant change to the carrying amount of an asset or liability

examples.en: The notes identified a risk of material adjustment to the carrying amount of the warehouse next year.
examples.zh: 附注指出，仓库账面金额下一年存在「重大调整风险」。

examples.en: The class discussed the risk of material adjustment when estimates depended heavily on one market assumption.
examples.zh: 估计很大程度上依赖一个市场假设，大家因此讨论了「重大调整风险」。

collocations: a significant risk of material adjustment
explain a risk of material adjustment
assess the risk of material adjustment to carrying amounts

words.enDefinition: Breaking return on investment into its profit margin and asset turnover components

examples.en: The tutor used ROI decomposition to explain which ratio changed between the two periods.
examples.zh: 导师用「投资回报率分解」来说明两个期间之间究竟哪个比率变了。

examples.en: Our ROI decomposition pointed to faster turnover even though profit margin was unchanged.
examples.zh: 我们通过「投资回报率分解」发现，虽然利润率未变，但周转加快了。

words.enDefinition: an average recalculated as a fixed-length period moves forward

examples.en: The group used a rolling average to show whether reported monthly expenses were trending higher.
examples.zh: 小组用「滚动平均值」查看所报告的月度费用是否有上升趋势。

examples.en: We recalculated the rolling average every month after adding the latest value and dropping the oldest.
examples.zh: 我们每月加入最新数值、去掉最早数值，再重新计算「滚动平均值」。

collocations: a chart of the rolling average

words.enDefinition: a regularly updated forecast that adds a future period to keep the planning horizon roughly constant

examples.en: The rolling forecast added another month after we entered actual bookings for the month just ended.
examples.zh: 录入刚结束月份的实际预约量后，「滚动预测」又延伸了一个月。

examples.en: We adjusted the rolling forecast after checking the latest repair orders and changes to opening hours.
examples.zh: 核对最新维修订单和开放时间变更后，我们调整了「滚动预测」。

words.zhGloss: 按当前水平推算的盈利
words.enDefinition: earnings projected by extending a recent operating pace
acceptedZhAnswers: 按当前水平推算的盈利

examples.en: The tutor discussed why run-rate earnings based on a busy holiday month might be misleading.
examples.zh: 导师讨论了为什么根据假日旺季某个月「按当前水平推算的盈利」可能造成误解。

examples.en: We distinguished run-rate earnings from actual results for the full year in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例中，我们区分了「按当前水平推算的盈利」和全年实际业绩。

collocations: compare run-rate earnings with reported profits

words.enDefinition: cash received upon selling investment holdings

examples.en: Our example recorded sale proceeds from investments when the company sold shares it held in another business.
examples.zh: 案例公司卖出持有的另一家企业的股份时，记录了「出售投资收到的款项」。

examples.en: We compared sale proceeds from investments with the original cost of the securities sold during the year.
examples.zh: 我们把「出售投资收到的款项」与年内售出证券的原始成本作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The margin effect of selling products in different proportions, keeping total actual volume constant and using standard margins.

examples.en: The sales mix variance was favourable because high-margin notebooks accounted for a larger share of units sold.
examples.zh: 高边际贡献笔记本的销量占比更高，因此「销售组合差异」有利。

examples.en: We left total sales units unchanged when we calculated the sales mix variance for the two models.
examples.zh: 计算两款商品的「销售组合差异」时，我们保持销售总数量不变。

collocations: separate the sales mix variance from the quantity effect

words.enDefinition: The effect on revenue of selling actual quantities at prices different from their standards or budgeted prices.

examples.en: The sales price variance was adverse because the print stall charged less per poster than it had planned.
examples.zh: 印刷摊实际每张海报的售价低于计划，所以「销售价格差异」不利。

examples.en: We held the number of bags sold constant to isolate the sales price variance in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习里，我们保持售出的包数不变，以单独算出「销售价格差异」。

collocations: separate the sales price variance from volume

words.zhGloss: 按预算组合计的销量差异
words.enDefinition: The change in standard margin due to selling more or fewer total units, holding the budgeted sales proportions constant.
acceptedZhAnswers: 按预算组合计的销量差异

examples.en: In class, we held the planned sales proportions constant to calculate the sales quantity variance for both snacks.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，我们保持计划销售比例不变，计算两种零食的「按预算组合计的销量差异」。

examples.en: The sales quantity variance was adverse after the stall sold fewer packs overall than the exercise had budgeted.
examples.zh: 摊位卖出的总包数低于练习里的预算，出现了不利的「按预算组合计的销量差异」。

collocations: value the sales quantity variance at standard margins

words.enDefinition: each joint product's total sales value at the point where it first becomes separately identifiable

examples.en: The table showed sales value at split-off before adding any amount for later painting or finishing.
examples.zh: 表格列出的是「分离点销售价值」，还没计入之后喷漆或后道加工增加的价值。

examples.en: We allocated joint costs in proportion to the sales value at split-off of each output grade.
examples.zh: 我们按各产出等级的「分离点销售价值」所占比例分配联合成本。

collocations: allocate using sales value at split-off

words.enDefinition: The change in contribution from selling a different volume from the budget, valued at standard contribution per unit.
acceptedZhAnswers: 按边际贡献计算的销量差异

examples.en: The sales volume contribution variance was favourable after the stall sold more tote bags than the budget assumed.
examples.zh: 摊位卖出的手提袋超过预算数量，出现了有利的「销量边际贡献差异」。

examples.en: In the case, the sales volume contribution variance used the planned contribution on every additional notebook sold.
examples.zh: 案例计算「销量边际贡献差异」时，每多卖出一本笔记本都按计划单位边际贡献计。

collocations: calculate the sales volume contribution variance
a favourable sales volume contribution variance
value the sales volume contribution variance at standard contribution

words.enDefinition: The effect of a change in sales volume measured at standard profit per unit under absorption costing.
acceptedZhAnswers: 按单位利润计算的销量差异

examples.en: For the absorption costing exercise, we valued the sales volume profit variance using standard profit per bag.
examples.zh: 在完全成本法练习中，我们按每个包的标准利润计算「销量利润差异」。

examples.en: The sales volume profit variance was adverse because kit sales fell short of the budgeted quantity.
examples.zh: 套件销量低于预算数量，因此「销量利润差异」不利。

collocations: calculate the sales volume profit variance
value the sales volume profit variance at standard profit
explain a favourable sales volume profit variance

words.enDefinition: The effect of a change in the number of units sold on revenue, valued at the budgeted selling price.
acceptedZhAnswers: 按售价计算的销量差异

examples.en: The sales volume revenue variance was adverse because fewer tickets sold, even though ticket prices stayed unchanged.
examples.zh: 门票价格没变，但售出的票数减少，因此「销量收入差异」不利。

examples.en: We multiplied the difference in units sold by the budgeted price to find the sales volume revenue variance.
examples.zh: 我们用实际与预算销量的差额乘以预算单价，算出「销量收入差异」。

collocations: calculate the sales volume revenue variance
an adverse sales volume revenue variance
separate the sales volume revenue variance from the price effect

words.expression: schedule of cost of goods manufactured
words.lemma: schedule of cost of goods manufactured
words.enDefinition: a statement reconciling manufacturing costs and changes in work in process to determine completed production costs
acceptedEnVariants: schedule of cost of goods manufactured

examples.en: The schedule of cost of goods manufactured showed opening unfinished work above the new production costs.
examples.zh: 「完工产品成本计算表」把期初在产品列在新增生产成本上方。

examples.en: We prepared a schedule of cost of goods manufactured before completing the example income statement.
examples.zh: 我们先编制「完工产品成本计算表」，再填完示例利润表。

collocations: prepare a schedule of cost of goods manufactured
review the schedule of cost of goods manufactured
read a schedule of cost of goods manufactured

words.enDefinition: Cash received from selling unusable materials or assets as scrap

examples.en: The class counted the lost scrap proceeds when the old material was reused.
examples.zh: 旧材料被拿来再用时，全班计入了因此放弃的「材料报废变卖收入」。

examples.en: Our table listed scrap proceeds beside the unused steel in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们的表在闲置钢材旁列出了「材料报废变卖收入」。

words.enDefinition: the amount expected from selling or recovering materials left over or rejected during production

examples.en: We estimated the scrap value of the offcuts before calculating the net cost of spoiled units.
examples.zh: 我们先估了边角料的「废料残值」，再算废品的净损失。

examples.en: The worksheet recorded a small scrap value for the metal left after cutting the brackets.
examples.zh: 练习表给切完支架剩下的金属记了一笔小额「废料残值」。

words.enDefinition: The sales level where a segment's margin reaches zero

examples.en: We calculated the segment break-even point using the outlet's traceable fixed costs and its contribution per sale.
examples.zh: 我们用该门店自身的可追溯固定成本和每笔销售的边际贡献计算「分部盈亏平衡点」。

examples.en: Our class calculated the segment break-even point before comparing two proposed sales levels.
examples.zh: 全班先算出「分部盈亏平衡点」，再对比两个拟议的销售水平。

collocations: sales above the segment break-even point

words.enDefinition: Segment revenue less the variable costs of earning that revenue

examples.en: The segment contribution margin rose when the unit sold more without changing prices.
examples.zh: 该单位价格不变、销量上升后，「分部边际贡献」提高了。

examples.en: We found segment contribution margin before subtracting the unit's traceable fixed costs.
examples.zh: 我们在扣除该单位可追溯的固定成本之前，先计算了「分部边际贡献」。

words.enDefinition: Ending the operations of a business segment or product line

examples.en: The worksheet retained central rent after segment discontinuation in the sample comparison.
examples.zh: 在样本比较里，练习表保留了「停办分部」之后仍要付的总部租金。

examples.en: We discussed which wages might stop as a result of segment discontinuation.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「停办分部」后哪些工资可能不用再付。

words.enDefinition: An internal statement showing revenue and costs by business segment

examples.en: The segment income statement put the bookshop and print service in separate columns.
examples.zh: 「分部利润表」把书店和打印服务列在不同栏位。

examples.en: We compared two formats for the segment income statement in our class exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中比较了「分部利润表」的两种格式。

collocations: lines on a segment income statement

words.enDefinition: A segment's contribution margin less its own traceable fixed costs

examples.en: The tutor calculated segment margin before deducting expenses shared across all units.
examples.zh: 导师在扣除各单位共同承担的费用前，先算出「分部边际利润」。

examples.en: The worksheet showed a positive segment margin after deducting the equipment lease cost.
examples.zh: 扣除设备租赁费后，练习表上的「分部边际利润」仍为正。

words.enDefinition: A segment's margin expressed as a percentage of its revenue

examples.en: The segment margin percentage helped compare two outlets with very different sales volumes.
examples.zh: 「分部边际利润率」便于比较两家销量相差很大的门店。

examples.en: We put segment margin percentage below the corresponding dollar amounts in the report.
examples.zh: 我们在报告相应的金额下方列出了「分部边际利润率」。

words.enDefinition: The business unit providing goods or services in an internal transfer

examples.en: The selling division recorded revenue even though no customer outside the group paid.
examples.zh: 尽管集团没有收到外部顾客付款，「内部供货分部」仍记录了收入。

examples.en: We checked whether the selling division had enough time to produce both orders.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「内部供货分部」是否有时间生产两笔订单。

collocations: revenue recorded by the selling division

words.zhGloss: 对假设变化的敏感程度

acceptedZhAnswers: 对假设变化的敏感程度

examples.en: The note showed sensitivity to assumptions about how many buyers would claim rebates after the promotion.
examples.zh: 附注展示了估计金额「对假设变化的敏感程度」，这里的假设涉及促销后有多少买家会申请返利。

examples.en: Our tutor compared sensitivity to assumptions across two estimates using the same hypothetical change in demand.
examples.zh: 老师假设需求变化相同，比较了两项估计「对假设变化的敏感程度」。

collocations: show an estimate's sensitivity to assumptions

words.enDefinition: costs incurred after the split-off point that can be traced to individual products

examples.en: We recorded polishing and packaging as separable costs because each of those tasks applied to one output.
examples.zh: 我们把抛光和包装列为「分离后可归属成本」，因为每项作业都对应单一产出。

examples.en: The worksheet deducted separable costs from the expected final sales value before allocating joint cost.
examples.zh: 练习表从预计最终销售价值中扣除「分离后可归属成本」，再分配联合成本。

words.enDefinition: growth compared with the immediately preceding period

examples.en: The report showed sequential growth by comparing third-quarter sales with the figures for the second quarter.
examples.zh: 报告将第三季度销售额与第二季度数据比较，展示「环比增长」。

examples.en: We calculated sequential growth from one month to the next in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 在课堂练习中，我们计算了相邻两个月的「环比增长」。

collocations: sequential growth from the previous quarter

words.enDefinition: a cost centre that accumulates the cost of internal services provided to other organisational units

examples.en: The service cost centre collected the repair team's costs before assigning them to production departments.
examples.zh: 「辅助服务成本中心」先归集维修团队的成本，再分配给生产部门。

examples.zh: 我们按各部门使用的维护工时分摊「辅助服务成本中心」归集的费用。

collocations: allocate a service cost centre's costs

words.enDefinition: determining and assigning the cost of providing a service, often per measurable unit

examples.en: We used service costing to estimate the cost per hour of equipment support at the university.
examples.zh: 我们用「服务成本核算」估计学校每小时设备支持的成本。

examples.en: The lecturer explained how service costing differed between a repair desk and a delivery service.
examples.zh: 讲师解释了维修台和送货服务的「服务成本核算」有什么不同。

words.enDefinition: a department that provides support to other departments rather than producing the organisation's main output

examples.en: The campus printing centre had a service department that maintained the equipment used for production.
examples.zh: 校园印刷中心有个「辅助服务部门」，负责维护生产使用的设备。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why a service department might share its costs across two production areas.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么一个「辅助服务部门」的成本会由两个生产区分摊。

words.enDefinition: assigning the costs of internal support departments to the operating departments or other units they serve

examples.en: We used service department cost allocation to distribute equipment maintenance costs among three production areas.
examples.zh: 我们用「辅助部门成本分配」把设备维护费分摊给三个生产区。

examples.en: The tutor explained why service department cost allocation mattered when both production areas used the same support team.
examples.zh: 导师解释了两个生产区共用一个支持团队时，为什么「辅助部门成本分配」很重要。

collocations: methods of service department cost allocation

words.enDefinition: the cost of providing one defined unit of a service, such as a repair or an hour of support

examples.en: We calculated the service unit cost of one hour at the student equipment repair desk.
examples.zh: 我们计算了学生器材维修台每小时的「单位服务成本」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which items were included in the service unit cost for each delivery.
examples.zh: 导师问，每次送货的「单位服务成本」纳入了哪些项目。

words.enDefinition: a measure of how much support a department receives, used as a basis for assigning costs

examples.en: We used the number of repair calls as a service usage measure for allocating maintenance costs.
examples.zh: 我们用报修次数作「内部服务用量指标」，分配维护成本。

examples.en: The lecturer asked whether the service usage measure reflected the time each department actually needed.
examples.zh: 讲师问，「内部服务用量指标」能否反映各部门实际需要的服务时间。

collocations: allocate costs using a service usage measure

words.enDefinition: Local change in the objective from one extra unit of capacity

examples.en: The model displayed the shadow price of capacity beside the machine hour limit.
examples.zh: 模型在机器工时限制旁列出了「产能影子价格」。

examples.en: We compared the shadow price of capacity with the quoted cost of another hour.
examples.zh: 我们把「产能影子价格」和再加一小时的报价作了比较。

collocations: estimate the shadow price of capacity
use the shadow price of capacity
a positive shadow price of capacity

words.enDefinition: an investment over a short period that can be readily converted to cash

examples.en: The company checked whether a short-term highly liquid investment met the other criteria for cash equivalents.
examples.zh: 公司评估该项「短期高流动性投资」是否满足归为现金等价物的其他条件。

examples.en: Our class compared a short-term highly liquid investment with the company's shares held for long-term growth.
examples.zh: 我们班把一项「短期高流动性投资」与公司为长期增值而持有的股份作了比较。

assess a short-term highly liquid investment
classify a short-term highly liquid investment

words.enDefinition: payments arising from leases that meet the applicable reporting definition of a short-term lease

examples.en: The model notes showed short-term lease payments for equipment rented during the company's temporary warehouse expansion.
examples.zh: 示例附注列出了公司临时扩充仓储期间租用设备的「短期租赁付款」。

examples.zh: 在我们的 IFRS 练习中，适用豁免的「短期租赁付款」列在报表的经营部分。

words.enDefinition: A material financing benefit provided to either party by the timing of payments relative to promised transfers under IFRS 15.

examples.zh: 付款日远晚于交付日，因此全班核查有无「重大融资成分」。

words.enDefinition: Notes explaining decisions in applying accounting policies that have the most significant effects on recognised amounts, apart from estimates.

examples.en: The significant judgement disclosures explained why the group concluded that it controlled the smaller company.
examples.zh: 「重大判断披露」解释了集团为什么认定自己控制了那家较小的公司。

examples.en: We used the significant judgement disclosures to understand how the sample report classified the supplier arrangement.
examples.zh: 我们用「重大判断披露」了解示例报告怎样对供应商安排进行分类。

words.enDefinition: Assumptions and conditions that make amounts in financial statements uncertain and can lead to later revisions.

examples.en: The property note discussed sources of estimation uncertainty such as future occupancy and expected rental income.
examples.zh: 物业附注讨论了未来出租率、预计租金收入等「估计不确定性的来源」。

examples.zh: 我们组先找出「估计不确定性的来源」，再试着读懂例题里的数字。

words.enDefinition: A division's freedom to choose whether to purchase internally or externally

examples.en: Because the division had sourcing autonomy, it could switch to an outside supplier with better delivery terms.
examples.zh: 事业部拥有「采购来源自主权」，因此可以换成配送条件更好的外部供应商。

examples.zh: 练习问，「采购来源自主权」是否可以和统一定价规则并存？

words.enDefinition: Production ability not required for the current level of activity

examples.zh: 那天下午，两台打印机还有空，因此工作室尚有「闲置产能」。

words.enDefinition: The sales proceeds expected from accepting an unusual customer order

examples.zh: 在乳品加工的例题中，奶油和脱脂奶到「分离点」时就可以作为不同产品辨认。

examples.zh: 练习册问，每种产品在「分离点」之后发生了哪些加工成本。

examples.en: We estimated the stand-alone selling price of the training because it was usually sold with equipment.
examples.zh: 培训通常与设备一同出售，因此我们估算了培训的「单独售价」。

examples.zh: 练习表先对比各项「单独售价」，再将合同价格分摊给两项履约义务。

words.enDefinition: The standard selling price per unit less the standard variable cost per unit.

examples.en: The exercise gave the standard contribution per unit for each size of bag before asking about sales mix.
examples.zh: 练习先给出每种尺寸袋子的「标准单位边际贡献」，再问销售组合的问题。

examples.zh: 我们用「标准单位边际贡献」计算售出数量变化带来的金额影响。

words.enDefinition: An internal charge based on preset costs for goods or services

examples.zh: 当月实际生产成本上升时，「标准成本内部转移价」仍保持不变。

examples.en: We checked the cost standard behind the standard-cost transfer price in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上查了「标准成本内部转移价」依据的成本标准。
