examples.zh: 我们把「单位产品标准材料用量」乘以通过检查的笔记本数量。

collocations: set the standard material quantity per unit
check the standard material quantity per unit
multiply the standard material quantity per unit by output

words.zhGloss: 按实际总投入量折算的标准配比用量
words.enDefinition: The quantities each material would account for if the total actual input followed the standard proportions.
acceptedZhAnswers: 按实际总投入量折算的标准配比用量

examples.en: The standard mix for actual input kept the same total weight, but divided it according to the recipe.
examples.zh: 「按实际总投入量折算的标准配比用量」保持总重量不变，按配方把它分到各材料。

examples.en: We compared each flour's measured weight with the standard mix for actual input before valuing the difference.
examples.zh: 我们把每种面粉的实测重量与「按实际总投入量折算的标准配比用量」比较，再计算差额金额。

collocations: calculate the standard mix for actual input
value the standard mix for actual input
compare actual quantities with the standard mix for actual input

words.enDefinition: The planned quantity of usable output per unit of input under standard operating conditions.

examples.en: The standard output yield allowed a little dough to remain in the bowl after each mixing cycle.
examples.zh: 制定「标准产出率」时，已考虑到每次搅拌后碗里会残留一点面团。

examples.en: Our tutor gave the standard output yield as usable sheets per kilogram of pulp in the exercise.
examples.zh: 老师在练习里用每公斤纸浆能制成的可用纸张数表示「标准产出率」。

collocations: compare with the standard output yield
calculate the standard output yield per kilogram

words.enDefinition: For an absorption costing sales variance, standard selling price less standard full production cost per unit.

examples.en: Our exercise deducted standard full production costs to determine the standard profit per unit for each kit.
examples.zh: 练习扣除了标准完全生产成本，以确定每个套件的「标准单位利润」。

examples.en: The absorption costing worksheet valued the shortfall in units sold at standard profit per unit.
examples.zh: 完全成本法练习表按「标准单位利润」计算少卖这些单位带来的金额影响。

collocations: calculate the standard profit per unit
value units at standard profit per unit
the standard profit per unit under absorption costing

words.zhGloss: 实际产量对应的标准用量
words.enDefinition: The amount of input allowed by the standard for the number of finished units actually produced.
acceptedZhAnswers: 实际产量对应的标准用量

examples.en: In the bakery case, the standard quantity allowed depended on how many rolls passed the quality check.
examples.zh: 在烘焙店案例中，「实际产量对应的标准用量」取决于有多少面包卷通过质检。

examples.en: Actual fabric use exceeded the standard quantity allowed for the number of bags the class produced.
examples.zh: 针对全班实际做出的包数，实际布料用量超出「实际产量对应的标准用量」。

collocations: use less than the standard quantity allowed
value the standard quantity allowed at standard price

words.enDefinition: The expected amount of unusable material built into a production standard for normal cutting or processing losses.

examples.en: The standard scrap allowance covered the narrow strips left after cutting panels from a rectangular sheet.
examples.zh: 「标准废料定额」包含从矩形板材切出面板后留下的窄条。

examples.en: The team exceeded the standard scrap allowance after it discovered several templates had been cut backwards.
examples.zh: 团队发现有几个样板剪反了，也因此超出了「标准废料定额」。

collocations: include a standard scrap allowance in the material estimate

words.enDefinition: The steps used to establish expected quantities, times and prices for standard cost calculations.

examples.en: The standard-setting process drew on supplier quotes and timed trials carried out in the campus workshop.
examples.zh: 「标准制定流程」参考了供应商报价和在校园工场开展的计时试验。

examples.en: The class interviewed the workshop supervisor to understand the standard-setting process behind the repair exercise.
examples.zh: 班里同学采访了工场负责人，了解维修练习背后的「标准制定流程」。

collocations: involve technicians in the standard-setting process

words.enDefinition: the profit or loss subtotal from which an indirect cash flow reconciliation begins

examples.en: The worksheet marked the starting subtotal before listing the adjustments for non-cash income and expenses.
examples.zh: 练习表在列示非现金收入和费用的调整前，标出了「调节起始小计」。

examples.en: With IFRS 18 applied, the worksheet used operating profit as the starting subtotal for its indirect reconciliation.
examples.zh: 采用 IFRS 18 后，练习表以营业利润作为间接法的「调节起始小计」。

collocations: use operating profit as the starting subtotal

words.enDefinition: a formal declaration of compliance with the identified accounting standards, explicit and unreserved where the applicable framework requires

examples.en: The notes included a statement of compliance identifying the reporting standards used for the example accounts.
examples.zh: 附注包含一份「准则遵循声明」，指出示例报表遵循哪些财务报告准则。

examples.en: Our tutor asked where the IFRS statement of compliance appeared in the sample annual report.
examples.zh: 老师问，示例年报里的哪份「准则遵循声明」表明财务报表按国际财务报告准则编制。

collocations: an unreserved statement of compliance with IFRS

words.zhGloss: 实际结果与静态预算的差异
words.enDefinition: The difference between actual results and the original budget at its planned activity level.
acceptedZhAnswers: 实际结果与静态预算的差异

examples.en: The static-budget variance included the effects of both selling fewer units and charging a lower price.
examples.zh: 「实际结果与静态预算的差异」包含销量减少和实际售价较低这两方面的影响。

examples.en: We broke the static-budget variance into two parts to see how much came from sales volume.
examples.zh: 我们把「实际结果与静态预算的差异」分成两部分，看其中多少来自销量。

collocations: compare the static-budget variance with its components

words.enDefinition: a method allocating support costs in sequence, including some services between support departments

examples.en: The step-down allocation method assigned the maintenance team's costs first because it supported several departments.
examples.zh: 「阶梯分配法」先分配维护团队的成本，因为它为多个部门提供支持。

examples.en: We compared two results from the step-down allocation method after reversing the order of allocation.
examples.zh: 我们颠倒分配顺序后，比较了「阶梯分配法」算出的两个结果。

collocations: choose the order for the step-down allocation method

words.enDefinition: an indirect cash flow adjustment that adds back an equity-settled compensation expense included in the starting profit amount

examples.en: The stock-based compensation add-back removed the effect of an employee share expense that required no cash payment.
examples.zh: 「股份支付费用加回」剔除了无需付现的员工股份费用对调节结果的影响。

examples.en: No stock-based compensation add-back appeared in the example because the company's bonuses were all paid in cash.
examples.zh: 示例没有出现「股份支付费用加回」，因为该公司的奖金全部用现金发放。

words.enDefinition: to defer paying suppliers, which can temporarily preserve cash at the expense of slower settlement

examples.en: Some companies stretch supplier payments when they face a temporary shortage of cash for everyday operations.
examples.zh: 有些公司日常经营现金暂时不足时，会「拉长供应商付款周期」。

examples.en: The analyst asked whether the company could stretch supplier payments again without losing early payment discounts.
examples.zh: 分析员问，这家公司能否再次「拉长供应商付款周期」而不失去提前付款折扣。

collocations: stretch supplier payments during a cash shortage

words.enDefinition: Payment to another business for doing part of contracted work

examples.en: The worksheet added subcontracting cost for the cutting work handled off site.
examples.zh: 练习表计入了在场外完成切割工序的「转包费用」。

examples.en: Our comparison showed subcontracting cost beside the cost of using staff overtime.
examples.zh: 我们的比较把「转包费用」列在员工加班成本旁边。

words.enDefinition: a decision made by a division that gives the organisation a worse result than an available alternative

examples.en: The case showed a suboptimal divisional decision caused by the reporting incentives.
examples.zh: 案例展示了报告考核激励如何导致「损害整体的分部决策」。

examples.en: The class traced a suboptimal divisional decision to the way each unit was rewarded.
examples.zh: 全班发现，这项「损害整体的分部决策」缘于各部门的奖励方式。

collocations: an example of a suboptimal divisional decision

words.enDefinition: The financial statement note describing relevant events occurring after the reporting period.

examples.en: The subsequent events note described an acquisition agreed after the end of the financial year.
examples.zh: 「日后事项附注」介绍了财务年度结束后达成的一项收购。

examples.en: We checked the subsequent events note before drawing conclusions about the company's position at year end.
examples.zh: 在对公司年末财务状况作出判断前，我们查看了「日后事项附注」。

collocations: include information in the subsequent events note

words.enDefinition: Determining the reported amount of an item after its initial recognition.

examples.en: The exercise separated the purchase entry from subsequent measurement after the company began using the machine.
examples.zh: 设备投入使用后，练习把购入分录与「后续计量」分开处理。

examples.en: We compared two policies for subsequent measurement of the same equipment across the three sample reports.
examples.zh: 我们对比了三份示例报告对同一设备采用的两种「后续计量」政策。

collocations: review the requirements for subsequent measurement
select a model for subsequent measurement

words.zhGloss: 非现金交易的补充披露
words.enDefinition: supporting information about material investing or financing transactions that do not involve cash flows and are excluded from cash flow totals
acceptedZhAnswers: 非现金交易的补充披露

examples.en: The supplemental disclosure of non-cash transactions described how the company exchanged its shares for production machinery.
examples.zh: 「非现金交易的补充披露」说明了公司如何用股份换取生产机器。

examples.en: Our example included a supplemental disclosure of non-cash transactions with the initial recognition of a lease liability.
examples.zh: 我们的示例采用「非现金交易的补充披露」，说明某项租赁负债的初始确认。

collocations: provide a supplemental disclosure of non-cash transactions
review the supplemental disclosure of non-cash transactions
read the supplemental disclosure of non-cash transactions

words.enDefinition: an arrangement in which a finance provider offers to settle supplier invoices and the buyer repays the provider

examples.en: The supplier finance arrangement let participating suppliers receive payments sooner while the buyer paid the provider later.
examples.zh: 通过「供应商融资安排」，参与的供应商可以提前收款，买方以后再向融资方支付。

examples.en: The note explained the payment terms of a supplier finance arrangement used by the company during the year.
examples.zh: 附注解释了公司本年采用的一项「供应商融资安排」的付款条件。

collocations: enter into a supplier finance arrangement

words.enDefinition: reporting information about supplier finance, such as payment terms, involved liabilities and associated liquidity risks

examples.en: The IAS 7 supplier finance disclosure identified outstanding liabilities for invoices the provider had already paid.
examples.zh: IAS 7 的「供应商融资披露」列出了融资方已向供应商付款、买方仍未清偿的相应负债。

examples.en: We reviewed the supplier finance disclosure to find the range of payment dates for liabilities in the arrangement.
examples.zh: 我们查阅了「供应商融资披露」，了解安排内负债的付款日期范围。

words.enDefinition: An extra cost of changing from one supplier to another

examples.en: Training the team on new parts created a supplier switching cost in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例里，培训团队使用新零件产生了「更换供应商的成本」。

examples.en: The class included supplier switching cost alongside the new supplier's lower purchase price.
examples.zh: 全班在新供应商较低的采购价旁，也列了「更换供应商的成本」。

collocations: record a one-time supplier switching cost

words.enDefinition: the cost of an activity or department that enables other organisational work

examples.en: We included a support cost for maintaining the booking system used by both workshop areas.
examples.zh: 我们计入了一笔「支持职能成本」，用于维护两个工作区都用的预约系统。

examples.en: The tutor asked why a support cost had been assigned entirely to one production department.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么一笔「支持职能成本」完全计入了一个生产部门。

words.enDefinition: earnings likely to continue under ordinary business conditions

examples.en: We discussed sustainable earnings after separating the gain from the retailer's one-time warehouse sale.
examples.zh: 我们单独列出零售商一次性出售仓库的收益后，讨论了「可持续盈利」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which parts of the year's profit could count as sustainable earnings.
examples.zh: 导师问，该年利润的哪些部分可算作「可持续盈利」。

words.enDefinition: applying the same principle to comparable gains and losses

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the sample's symmetrical treatment applied to comparable gains as well as charges.
examples.zh: 导师问，样本的「对称处理」是否同时适用于可比的收益和费用。

examples.en: The exercise used symmetrical treatment when adjusting both gains and losses from similar disposals.
examples.zh: 练习调整类似处置产生的收益和损失时采用了「对称处理」。

collocations: symmetrical treatment of gains and losses

words.enDefinition: net income divided by pretax earnings in the DuPont breakdown

examples.en: The tax burden factor showed how much pretax income remained after tax in the classroom calculation.
examples.zh: 课堂计算用「税负因子」显示税前利润扣税后保留了多少。

examples.en: We calculated the tax burden factor before completing the five-part comparison in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先算了「税负因子」，再完成练习表里的五项比较。

words.enDefinition: the amount by which an adjustment changes the associated tax figure

examples.en: The sample note explained the tax effect of an adjustment linked to an unusually large charge.
examples.zh: 样本附注解释了一笔与异常大额费用有关的「调整的所得税影响」。

examples.en: We checked whether the tax effect of an adjustment was listed separately in the reconciliation.
examples.zh: 我们核对了调节表中是否单独列出「调整的所得税影响」。

collocations: calculate the tax effect of an adjustment
disclose the tax effect of an adjustment
estimate the tax effect of an adjustment

words.enDefinition: Increasing available output for a limited time to meet demand

examples.en: The case priced a temporary capacity expansion by renting equipment for two weeks.
examples.zh: 案例估算了通过租两周设备来「临时扩大产能」的费用。

examples.en: Our comparison treated temporary capacity expansion separately from committing to a new workshop.
examples.zh: 我们在对比中，把「临时扩大产能」和增设一个新工作室区分开。

collocations: cost of a temporary capacity expansion
compare options for temporary capacity expansion

words.enDefinition: the maximum achievable output or available time under ideal conditions with no interruptions

examples.en: The class calculated theoretical capacity before allowing for breaks and time spent replacing materials.
examples.zh: 课堂先算「理论产能」，然后才考虑休息和更换材料要花的时间。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why theoretical capacity was greater than the amount the workshop could normally deliver.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么「理论产能」比工作室平时能完成的工作量更大。

collocations: compare actual output with theoretical capacity

words.enDefinition: An approach improving overall performance by managing the most limiting factor

examples.en: The theory of constraints exercise focused first on the machine limiting production.
examples.zh: 「约束理论」练习首先关注那个限制生产的机器。

examples.en: We discussed the theory of constraints after seeing work accumulate before the finishing stage.
examples.zh: 我们看到半成品在收尾工序前堆积后，讨论了「约束理论」。

words.enDefinition: a decomposition of equity return into margin, asset turnover, and leverage

examples.en: In the three-step DuPont analysis, the worksheet multiplied net margin, asset turnover, and the equity multiplier.
examples.zh: 在「三因素杜邦分析」中，练习表将净利率、资产周转率与权益乘数相乘。

examples.en: The tutor asked which factor had changed most in the three-step DuPont analysis for the retailer.
examples.zh: 导师问，零售商的「三因素杜邦分析」中哪个因素变化最大。

collocations: factors in a three-step DuPont analysis

words.enDefinition: An approach focusing on throughput, operating expense, and constrained capacity

examples.en: The class used throughput accounting to compare two products sharing one machine.
examples.zh: 全班用「产出会计」比较了两种共用一台机器的产品。

examples.en: Our tutor introduced throughput accounting with a case involving limited finishing capacity.
examples.zh: 导师用受收尾工序产能限制的案例引入了「产出会计」。

collocations: compare throughput accounting with traditional costing

words.enDefinition: Return per constrained factory hour divided by cost per factory hour

examples.en: The throughput accounting ratio changed when the bottleneck moved to a different machine.
examples.zh: 当瓶颈转移到另一台机器时，「产出会计比率」发生了变化。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which product had the higher throughput accounting ratio in the comparison.
examples.zh: 导师问，在比较中哪种产品的「产出会计比率」更高。

words.enDefinition: Sales revenue less direct material cost under conventional throughput accounting

examples.en: The throughput contribution calculation deducted material costs from sales in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中计算「产出贡献」时，从销售收入中扣除了材料成本。

examples.en: We kept labour outside throughput contribution in this particular throughput accounting model.
examples.zh: 在这套产出会计模型里，我们计算「产出贡献」时没有扣人工成本。

words.enDefinition: an activity-based method using the cost per time unit of available capacity and the time needed for work

examples.en: We tested time-driven activity-based costing to find how much time rush orders used at the counter.
examples.zh: 我们试用「时间驱动作业成本法」，估算加急订单用了多少柜台时间。

examples.en: Our tutor introduced time-driven activity-based costing before comparing unused capacity across two different departments.
examples.zh: 导师先介绍「时间驱动作业成本法」，再比较两个不同部门的闲置产能。

words.enDefinition: an equation estimating how long an activity takes based on features of a transaction or job

examples.en: Our time equation added several minutes whenever the order needed its own separate packaging.
examples.zh: 订单需要单独包装时，我们的「作业耗时方程」就会多算几分钟。

examples.en: The lecturer checked whether the time equation included extra time for verifying unfamiliar account details.
examples.zh: 讲师核查「作业耗时方程」有没有计入确认陌生账户详情的额外时间。

collocations: estimate activity time with a time equation

words.zhGloss: 可追溯但不可控的成本
words.enDefinition: A cost attributable to a unit but outside its manager's control
acceptedZhAnswers: 可追溯但不可控的成本

examples.en: The rent set by head office was a traceable but uncontrollable cost for the branch.
examples.zh: 总部规定的房租是门店「可追溯但不可控的成本」。

examples.en: Our worksheet included a traceable but uncontrollable cost when assessing the unit's overall financial performance.
examples.zh: 评估该单位整体财务表现时，练习表计入了一项「可追溯但不可控的成本」。

collocations: identify a traceable but uncontrollable cost
show a traceable but uncontrollable cost
a traceable but uncontrollable cost in the report

words.enDefinition: A cost directly attributable to a specific segment, whether or not the segment manager controls it.

examples.en: The standalone studio lease was a traceable cost of the recording unit even though central office negotiated it.
examples.zh: 独立录音室的租约虽由总部谈妥，相关租金还是录音部门的「可归属成本」。

examples.en: In our case, the projector rental was a traceable cost of the short course that used it.
examples.zh: 案例中，投影仪租金是使用它的短期课程的「可归属成本」。

collocations: assign a traceable cost to a division
treat rent as a traceable cost

words.enDefinition: Fixed costs identifiable with a particular segment, regardless of controllability

examples.en: The unit's dedicated equipment lease was among its traceable fixed costs.
examples.zh: 该单位的专用设备租赁费是其「可追溯的固定成本」之一。

examples.en: We separated traceable fixed costs from expenses that supported both outlets together.
examples.zh: 我们把「可追溯的固定成本」与同时服务两家门店的费用分开了。

words.enDefinition: Divisional revenue less costs attributable directly to that division, whether or not its manager controls them.

examples.en: We included rent paid specifically for the workshop in traceable profit even though headquarters signed the lease.
examples.zh: 租约虽由总部签订，但工场专用场地的租金仍纳入「可归属利润」的计算。

examples.en: In the case, traceable profit excluded the central office costs shared by all three regional units.
examples.zh: 案例里的「可归属利润」没有扣除由三个地区部门分摊的总部成本。

collocations: compare traceable profit with controllable profit

words.enDefinition: moving an amount out of or into a trade payable presentation category when its circumstances support a different classification

examples.en: The report explained a trade payable reclassification after the company assessed the terms of its financing arrangement.
examples.zh: 公司评估其融资安排的条件后，报告说明了一项「应付账款重分类」。

examples.en: We checked whether the trade payable reclassification reflected new terms or a correction of the earlier presentation.
examples.zh: 我们核查了「应付账款重分类」反映了新条款，还是对先前列报的更正。

words.enDefinition: the twelve-month period ending at the latest stated date

examples.en: The chart used the trailing twelve months to compare both stores through the latest reporting month.
examples.zh: 图表用「最近十二个月」的数据比较两家商店截至最近报告月份的表现。

examples.en: We checked which quarterly totals made up the trailing twelve months in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对了练习中哪些季度总额合计构成「最近十二个月」的数据。

collocations: revenue for the trailing twelve months

words.zhGloss: 按作业次数计量的动因
words.enDefinition: a cost driver measuring how many times an activity is performed
acceptedZhAnswers: 按作业次数计量的动因

examples.en: The number of purchase orders was a transaction driver for the equipment office's ordering costs.
examples.zh: 采购订单数量是器材办公室订购成本的「按作业次数计量的动因」。

examples.en: We used a transaction driver because each recorded inspection took approximately the same amount of time.
examples.zh: 每次记录的检查花费时间大致一样，我们用了「按作业次数计量的动因」。

collocations: measure an activity with a transaction driver

words.enDefinition: Under IFRS 15, the consideration an entity expects for promised transfers, excluding amounts collected for third parties.

examples.en: The case estimated the transaction price after taking expected refunds into account for the goods sold.
examples.zh: 例题在估计「交易价格」时，考虑了已售货物可能要退还的款项。

examples.en: We allocated the transaction price between the equipment and the additional support promised in the contract.
examples.zh: 我们把「交易价格」分配给设备和合同承诺的额外支持服务。

words.enDefinition: A change to the charge used for an internal transaction

examples.en: The report showed a transfer price adjustment after the agreed component specification changed.
examples.zh: 约定的零件规格改变后，报告列出了「内部转移价调整」。

examples.en: We checked how a transfer price adjustment affected the two divisions' reported margins.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「内部转移价调整」如何影响两个分部报告的利润水平。

words.zhGloss: 可协商的内部转移价区间
words.enDefinition: The interval of internal prices acceptable to both divisions
acceptedZhAnswers: 可协商的内部转移价区间

examples.en: The transfer price range narrowed after the outside supplier lowered its offer.
examples.zh: 外部供应商降价后，「可协商的内部转移价区间」缩小了。

examples.en: The worksheet showed no transfer price range because the minimum exceeded the maximum.
examples.zh: 由于最低接受价超过最高接受价，练习表没有显示「可协商的内部转移价区间」。

collocations: negotiate within the transfer price range
find a workable transfer price range

words.enDefinition: A disagreement between divisions over the charge for an internal transaction

examples.en: Head office reviewed a transfer pricing dispute over the price of printed covers.
examples.zh: 总部复核了一起印刷封面价格的「内部转移定价争议」。

examples.en: The tutor used a transfer pricing dispute to illustrate competing divisional targets.
examples.zh: 导师用「内部转移定价争议」来说明各分部目标如何发生冲突。

words.enDefinition: Rules for setting charges between units of the same organisation

examples.en: The new transfer pricing policy used market quotes when comparable transactions were available.
examples.zh: 有可比交易时，新的「内部转移定价政策」采用市场报价。

examples.en: We checked the transfer pricing policy before evaluating the two units' reported profit.
examples.zh: 我们先查了「内部转移定价政策」，再评价两个单位公布的利润。

words.enDefinition: Costs arising only because a particular internal transfer takes place

examples.en: The round trip between sites created transfer-specific costs in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在练习表里，两处场地往返运输产生了「内部调拨专属成本」。

examples.en: We accounted for transfer-specific costs before comparing the outside quote with internal sourcing.
examples.zh: 我们比较外部报价和内部供货前，先计入了「内部调拨专属成本」。

collocations: add transfer-specific costs to the comparison

words.enDefinition: costs attached to units moved from an earlier production department into the current one

examples.en: The finishing department recorded transferred-in costs when it received partly completed notebooks from printing.
examples.zh: 后道加工部门收到印刷部门转来的半成品笔记本时，记录了「上道工序转入成本」。

examples.en: The exercise separated transferred-in costs from additional costs incurred in the current department that month.
examples.zh: 练习把「上道工序转入成本」与当月本部门新增成本分开列出。

words.enDefinition: movements between an entity's own cash accounts within the scope of the total reconciled in its cash flow statement

examples.en: Our transfers between cash accounts changed the distribution of funds but left the company's total cash balance unchanged.
examples.zh: 我们的「现金账户间划转」改变了资金分布，公司现金总额保持不变。

examples.en: The reconciliation excluded transfers between cash accounts from its operating, investing and financing cash flow totals.
examples.zh: 调节表的经营、投资和筹资现金流合计均不包括「现金账户间划转」。

words.enDefinition: Changes in fair value hierarchy classification between reporting dates, such as after observable market inputs become unavailable.
acceptedEnVariants: transfers between levels of the fair value hierarchy

examples.en: The note explained transfers between hierarchy levels after new market data became available for some instruments.
examples.zh: 部分金融工具有了新的市场数据后，附注说明了对应的「公允价值层次间转移」。

examples.en: Our group matched the reported transfers between hierarchy levels to the changes described in the valuation note.
examples.zh: 我们组把列报的「公允价值层次间转移」和估值附注中说明的变化对应起来。

collocations: report the timing of transfers between hierarchy levels

words.enDefinition: Rules within a new standard explaining how to move from the previous accounting requirements to the new ones.

examples.en: We read the transition provisions before deciding which comparative figures the classroom company would present.
examples.zh: 我们先看「过渡规定」，再判断课堂例题中的公司该列报哪些比较数据。

examples.en: The footnote described the transition provisions the group had followed when it first applied the standard.
examples.zh: 脚注说明了集团首次应用该准则时遵循的「过渡规定」。

collocations: disclose an election under transition provisions

words.enDefinition: using the exchange rates on the dates of transactions to express those transactions in the relevant currency

examples.en: The worked example used translation at transaction-date exchange rates for two foreign payments made in different months.
examples.zh: 这个例题对不同月份发生的两笔外币付款采用「按交易日汇率折算」。

examples.en: We compared translation at transaction-date exchange rates with the year-end remeasurement of the remaining cash balance.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「按交易日汇率折算」与在年末重新计量剩余现金余额的做法。

collocations: use translation at transaction-date exchange rates
apply translation at transaction-date exchange rates
check translation at transaction-date exchange rates

words.enDefinition: examining figures over time to identify a pattern

examples.en: Our trend analysis showed that product returns increased each year even though sales grew only slightly.
examples.zh: 我们的「趋势分析」显示，退货逐年增加，而销售额只略有增长。

examples.en: The tutor asked how a three-year trend analysis might hide an unusual quarter within the period.
examples.zh: 导师问，「趋势分析」跨越三年时，可能怎样掩盖其中一个异常季度。

words.enDefinition: An internal charge combining a per-unit amount with a fixed fee

examples.en: Our model split the two-part transfer price into a unit charge and monthly fee.
examples.zh: 我们把模型中的「两部制内部转移价」分成每件收费和月度固定费。

examples.en: The instructor compared a two-part transfer price with one charge per unit sold.
examples.zh: 导师把「两部制内部转移价」与单一的按件收费作了比较。

collocations: a fixed fee under a two-part transfer price

words.enDefinition: assigning costs from resources to intermediate pools or activities and then to final cost objects

examples.en: The model used two-stage allocation to assign equipment costs to activities and then to custom products.
examples.zh: 模型采用「两阶段成本分配」，把设备成本先计入作业，再分配给定制产品。

examples.en: We drew arrows showing each part of the two-stage allocation in the classroom printing example.
examples.zh: 我们给课堂印刷案例画了箭头，标明「两阶段成本分配」的各个环节。

words.enDefinition: The party at the top of the ownership or control chain that ultimately controls the reporting entity.

examples.en: The notes identified the ultimate controlling party separately from the company's immediate parent in the group structure.
examples.zh: 附注将「最终控制方」与集团结构中公司的直接母公司分开列出。

examples.en: We followed the chain of control to identify the ultimate controlling party in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们沿控制关系逐层追溯，找出了课堂例题中的「最终控制方」。

collocations: name the ultimate controlling party in the notes

words.enDefinition: indirect costs that have not been assigned to a cost object or included in allocated costs

examples.en: The example showed unallocated overhead separately from the costs already charged to finished products.
examples.zh: 例子把「未分配的间接费用」与已经计入完工产品的成本分开列出。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the unallocated overhead remained after the usual distribution at the end of the period.
examples.zh: 导师问，期末正常分配后为什么还有「未分配的间接费用」。

words.zhGloss: 集团无法调拨的现金余额
words.enDefinition: cash held within a reporting group that the group cannot freely transfer or access, even if available to the local entity
acceptedZhAnswers: 集团无法调拨的现金余额

examples.en: In the example, unavailable cash balances included overseas funds that the parent could not transfer to its account.
examples.zh: 示例中的「集团无法调拨的现金余额」包括母公司无法转入自己账户的海外资金。

examples.en: The financial statement note described unavailable cash balances and the local rules that limited transfers within the group.
examples.zh: 财务报表附注说明了「集团无法调拨的现金余额」和限制集团内转账的当地规定。

words.enDefinition: Under IAS 37 for an onerous contract, the lower of fulfilment costs and compensation or penalties for failing to fulfil it.

examples.en: We compared the cost of delivery with the amount payable for cancellation to find the unavoidable costs.
examples.zh: 我们对照交付成本和取消合同时应付的金额，以求出「不可避免的成本」。

examples.en: The exercise asked whether the contract's benefits would still cover the unavoidable costs after materials became more expensive.
examples.zh: 练习问，材料涨价后，合同经济利益是否仍能覆盖「不可避免的成本」。

collocations: determine unavoidable costs under the contract

words.enDefinition: A fixed cost that will remain under the alternatives being compared

examples.en: The lease payment was an unavoidable fixed cost even if the stall closed early.
examples.zh: 即使提前收摊，租赁款仍是「不可避免的固定成本」。

examples.en: Our worksheet carried the unavoidable fixed cost under both the keep and close options.
examples.zh: 我们的练习表把「不可避免的固定成本」同时列在保留和关闭两种方案下。

words.enDefinition: A difference caused by a factor outside the relevant manager's practical authority during the period being assessed.

examples.en: The case recorded an uncontrollable variance when the landlord changed a charge the unit manager could not influence.
examples.zh: 房东改了一项部门经理无法左右的收费，案例将其列为「不可控差异」。

examples.en: Our group labelled the central wage adjustment an uncontrollable variance for the local manager in the exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中，我们组把总部调整工资产生的差异列为当地经理的「不可控差异」。

words.enDefinition: the amount or situation when applied overhead is less than the overhead actually incurred

examples.en: We identified underapplied overhead because more indirect costs were incurred than had been charged to jobs.
examples.zh: 实际发生的间接费用多于计入各作业的金额，我们确认发生了「间接费用分配不足」。

examples.en: The underapplied overhead was shown as a debit balance in the example overhead account.
examples.zh: 示例的间接费用账户把「间接费用分配不足」显示为借方余额。

words.enDefinition: An amount by which spending is below the budget or allocation for the period.

examples.en: The rehearsal hall reported an underspend after its planned equipment service was moved to the next month.
examples.zh: 原定的设备保养移到下个月后，排练厅列报了「低于预算的金额」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the underspend was temporary or reflected a lasting drop in maintenance costs.
examples.zh: 老师问，这笔「低于预算的金额」是暂时的，还是反映维修费用长期下降。

words.enDefinition: an activity performed for each individual unit of a product or service

examples.en: Attaching a strap was a unit-level activity because every bag needed one before it was sold.
examples.zh: 装背带是「单位级作业」，每个包在出售前都要装一根。

examples.en: In the workbook, labelling each notebook was classified as a unit-level activity during final preparation.
examples.zh: 练习册把最后准备时逐本给笔记本贴标签归为「单位级作业」。

words.enDefinition: a right, obligation, or group of rights and obligations to which accounting recognition or measurement concepts are applied

examples.en: The workshop example used each machine as its unit of account when discussing recognition and measurement.
examples.zh: 工场例题讨论确认和计量时，把每台机器视作一个「会计处理单元」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the package of rights should be treated as one unit of account.
examples.zh: 老师问，这一组权利是否应当作为一个「会计处理单元」。

collocations: determine the appropriate unit of account
apply a measurement basis to the unit of account

words.enDefinition: the cost assigned to one unit of product under a specified costing method

examples.en: The workbook calculated unit product cost after the workshop finished all the banners for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 工作室做完展览用的全部横幅后，练习册计算了「单位产品成本」。

examples.en: Our unit product cost changed when we allocated part of the rent to the new batch.
examples.zh: 把部分租金分给新一批产品后，我们的「单位产品成本」发生了变化。

words.zhGloss: 已核对去向的实物数量
words.enDefinition: the units in a production schedule whose disposition is recorded, such as completed, lost or unfinished units
acceptedZhAnswers: 已核对去向的实物数量

examples.en: The units accounted for included completed units and those still waiting for a cover to be fitted.
examples.zh: 「已核对去向的实物数量」包括完工件和还没装上封面的件数。

examples.en: We checked that units accounted for matched the number reported as available during the period.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「已核对去向的实物数量」是否等于本期报告的可用实物总数。

words.enDefinition: units whose production began and ended within the current accounting period

examples.en: Our units started and completed excluded notebooks that were partly finished before the month began.
examples.zh: 「本期投产并完工数量」不包括月初之前已做完一部分的笔记本。

examples.en: The exercise presented units started and completed on a separate line in the FIFO calculation.
examples.zh: 练习在先进先出计算中单列「本期投产并完工数量」。

words.enDefinition: the opening units plus units started or transferred in that must be explained in a production schedule

examples.en: Our units to account for included the notebooks already in process at the start of April.
examples.zh: 我们的「待核对的实物数量」包括四月初已经在加工的笔记本。

examples.en: The tutor checked units to account for before reviewing what happened to the output that period.
examples.zh: 导师先查看「待核对的实物数量」，再看本期产量的去向。

collocations: compare units to account for with units accounted for

words.enDefinition: The part of an amount set aside for a specific purpose that has not yet been spent.

examples.en: The case showed an unspent allocation for training because the last workshop had been moved to spring.
examples.zh: 最后一场培训改在春季举行，因此案例中的培训经费还有「尚未使用的拨款」。

examples.en: At the review, we listed the unspent allocation separately from funds already committed to confirmed orders.
examples.zh: 评审时，我们把「尚未使用的拨款」和已经为确定订单承诺的款项分别列出。

words.enDefinition: the return to inventory of unused materials that were previously issued to a job or department

examples.en: The unused materials return reduced the fabric cost shown on the original job sheet.
examples.zh: 「剩余材料退库」冲减了原作业单上记录的布料成本。

examples.en: We recorded an unused materials return after finding that the display needed only two sheets of card.
examples.zh: 发现展示台只需两张卡纸后，我们登记了一次「剩余材料退库」。

words.enDefinition: The increase in the present value of a discounted balance due solely to the passage of time.
acceptedZhAnswers: 时间推移引起的折现摊回

examples.en: The provision increased through unwinding of the discount as another year passed before the scheduled restoration.
examples.zh: 距离预定恢复场地的日期又近了一年，预计负债因「折现摊回」而增加。

examples.en: The note showed unwinding of the discount separately from a change to expected restoration costs.
examples.zh: 附注把「折现摊回」和预计恢复成本的变动分开列示。

collocations: recognise the unwinding of the discount
a charge from unwinding of the discount
the effect of unwinding of the discount

words.enDefinition: Market data or assumptions entered into a technique to estimate an asset or liability value.

examples.en: We checked the valuation inputs before comparing the two reports on the same office building.
examples.zh: 我们在比较同一办公楼的两份报告之前，先核查了「估值输入值」。

examples.en: The note explained which valuation inputs came from market transactions and which relied on other evidence.
examples.zh: 附注说明哪些「估值输入值」来自市场交易，哪些依据其他证据。

words.enDefinition: A method of estimating an asset or liability value from market, cost, or income information.

examples.en: The notes described the valuation technique before listing the assumptions used to estimate the property value.
examples.zh: 附注先讲了「估值技术」，接着列出估算物业价值所用的假设。

examples.en: The class compared a valuation technique based on recent sales with one using expected rental income.
examples.zh: 全班对比了两种「估值技术」，分别依据近期售价与预计租金收入。

words.enDefinition: an activity that contributes value to the product or service in the eyes of the customer

examples.en: The class identified repairing a loose handle as a value-added activity when servicing a borrowed bicycle.
examples.zh: 课堂把维修借来的自行车时拧紧松动把手归为「增值作业」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether printing a personalised name counted as a value-added activity for the workshop.
examples.zh: 导师问，对工作室而言，印上顾客定制的姓名算不算「增值作业」。

words.enDefinition: In the IFRS impairment model, the present value of cash flows expected from using and ultimately disposing of an asset or unit.

examples.en: In the impairment case, we estimated value in use for equipment that the company planned to keep operating.
examples.zh: 在减值例题中，我们估算了公司打算继续使用的设备的「使用价值」。

examples.en: The tutor explained how cash expected at disposal was included in the calculation of value in use.
examples.zh: 老师解释了计算「使用价值」时怎样计入处置资产预计收到的现金。

collocations: compare value in use with carrying amount

words.enDefinition: Consideration under a contract that may change because of refunds, bonuses, discounts or other uncertain factors.

examples.en: The tutor pointed out variable consideration because the service fee included a bonus for early completion.
examples.zh: 由于服务费含提前完工奖金，老师指出其中有「可变对价」。

examples.en: The example updated variable consideration after more customers claimed the rebate than the company had originally expected.
examples.zh: 申请返利的顾客多于公司起初预期，因此例题更新了「可变对价」。

collocations: constrain an estimate of variable consideration
update variable consideration at period end

words.enDefinition: An internal charge set at the transferred item’s variable cost

examples.en: The workbook showed a variable-cost transfer price based on the unit’s material and labour costs.
examples.zh: 练习册列出了按单位材料和人工成本计算的「变动成本内部转移价」。

examples.en: Our group calculated a variable-cost transfer price after the component material price changed.
examples.zh: 零件材料价格变动后，我们组计算了「变动成本内部转移价」。

collocations: compare a variable-cost transfer price with market price

words.enDefinition: an income statement that deducts variable expenses from sales to show contribution margin before fixed expenses

examples.en: The variable costing income statement grouped expenses by behaviour and reported contribution margin near the middle.
examples.zh: 「变动成本法利润表」按成本性态归类费用，在中段报告边际贡献。

examples.en: We used a variable costing income statement to see how additional sales affected the contribution margin.
examples.zh: 我们用「变动成本法利润表」查看增加的销量怎样影响边际贡献。

collocations: prepare a variable costing income statement
review the variable costing income statement
compare a variable costing income statement with absorption costing

words.enDefinition: payments under a lease whose amount varies because of changes in facts or circumstances after commencement

examples.en: The example linked variable lease payments to sales at the shop during the term of the lease.
examples.zh: 示例将「可变租赁付款」与租赁期内这家店的销售额挂钩。

examples.en: Under IFRS 16, variable lease payments excluded from the lease liability measurement appeared in operating cash flows.
examples.zh: 按照 IFRS 16，未纳入租赁负债计量的「可变租赁付款」列在经营现金流中。

words.expression: variance as a percentage of budget
words.lemma: variance as a percentage of budget
words.enDefinition: the difference between actual and budgeted amounts expressed as a percentage of the budgeted amount when that amount is nonzero
acceptedEnVariants: variance as a percentage of budget

examples.en: The tutor asked us to show each variance as a percentage of budget alongside its amount in dollars.
examples.zh: 老师让我们在每项差异的美元金额旁注明该项「差异占预算的百分比」。

examples.en: Showing variance as a percentage of budget made the two workshops easier to compare.
examples.zh: 列出「差异占预算的百分比」后，就更容易比较两间工场的数据。

collocations: calculate a variance as a percentage of budget
report a variance as a percentage of budget
compare each variance as a percentage of budget

words.enDefinition: A breakdown, often shown as a chart, that reconciles a starting figure to an ending figure through separate effects.

examples.en: The variance bridge began with budgeted profit and showed how price and volume led to the actual figure.
examples.zh: 「差异桥接图」从预算利润起步，展示价格和销量如何一步步影响到实际利润。

examples.en: Our group used a variance bridge to show why lower supply costs did not offset the revenue decline.
examples.zh: 我们小组用「差异桥接图」解释为什么物料成本降低无法抵消收入下降。

collocations: show the volume effect in a variance bridge

words.enDefinition: A written explanation of the main differences identified in a comparison with budget or standard.

examples.en: The variance commentary linked the higher printing cost to a small batch that needed special paper.
examples.zh: 「差异说明」指出印刷成本偏高是因为有一小批产品用了特种纸。

examples.en: Our group kept the variance commentary short and referred readers to the calculation for each figure.
examples.zh: 我们小组把「差异说明」写得简短，并提醒读者查每个数字对应的计算。

collocations: add variance commentary to the report

words.enDefinition: A major factor that explains why an actual figure differs from its budget or standard.

examples.en: The class identified discounted ticket prices as the main variance driver after checking attendance for both performances.
examples.zh: 全班核对了两场演出的到场人数后，把票价打折确定为「差异的主要成因」。

examples.en: The workshop report treated poor fabric yield as a variance driver and explained its effect on unit costs.
examples.zh: 工场报告把布料出成率低列为「差异的成因」，并解释了它对单位成本的影响。

collocations: explain a variance driver in the report

words.enDefinition: Work done after a variance is flagged to confirm its cause and track any agreed response.

examples.en: The variance follow-up showed that the extra charge had been billed to the wrong class project.
examples.zh: 「差异跟进」发现，这笔额外收费记到了错误的课堂项目上。

examples.en: We moved the unresolved supply difference to the next meeting's agenda for variance follow-up and discussion.
examples.zh: 我们把尚未解决的物料差异列入下次会议议程，以便「差异跟进」和讨论。

words.enDefinition: The review of a reported variance to verify it and determine what caused it.

examples.en: The variance investigation began when the electricity charge for the practice workshop rose without a change in hours.
examples.zh: 练习工场工时未变，电费却上涨，于是开始了「差异调查」。

examples.en: A variance investigation revealed that two batches of cups had been counted in the wrong month.
examples.zh: 「差异调查」发现，有两批杯子被算进了错误的月份。

words.enDefinition: The person assigned to investigate a reported variance and explain or coordinate follow-up on it.

examples.en: We named a variance owner for the unplanned rental charge so one person could check the invoices.
examples.zh: 我们为这笔未计划的租赁费指定了「差异跟进责任人」，由一人去核查发票。

examples.en: The variance owner reported that the difference came from a late delivery billed in the following month.
examples.zh: 「差异跟进责任人」指出，这项差异来自一次晚到、在次月入账的送货。

collocations: ask the variance owner for an update

words.enDefinition: A document that shows differences between actual figures and a budget or standard, sometimes with explanations.

examples.en: The variance report showed that paper costs were on plan but overtime costs were higher than expected.
examples.zh: 「差异报告」显示纸张成本符合计划，但加班成本高于预期。

examples.en: Our tutor asked for a variance report that separated price changes from changes in quantities sold.
examples.zh: 老师要求提交一份把价格变化和销量变化分开列示的「差异报告」。

collocations: add commentary to a variance report

words.enDefinition: An amount or percentage used to decide which budget differences warrant reporting or investigation.

examples.en: The class set a variance threshold so its practice report would focus on the largest unexplained differences.
examples.zh: 全班设定了「差异关注阈值」，让练习报告集中在尚未解释的大额差异上。

examples.en: The repair line exceeded the variance threshold when we expressed its small difference as a percentage.
examples.zh: 维修项目的金额差异不大，但换算成百分比后就超出了「差异关注阈值」。

words.enDefinition: expressing statement items relative to a common amount within that statement

examples.en: The class used vertical analysis to express each expense as a percentage of total revenue.
examples.zh: 同学们用「纵向分析」把每项费用表示为其占总收入的比例。

examples.en: Our vertical analysis expressed each asset category as a share of the firm's total assets.
examples.zh: 我们的「纵向分析」把各类资产表示为其占公司总资产的比例。

collocations: vertical analysis of a balance sheet

words.enDefinition: An inflow of economic benefits whose receipt is sufficiently certain that the asset is no longer contingent under IAS 37.

examples.en: The accounting exercise treated the confirmed settlement as a virtually certain inflow when discussing the related asset.
examples.zh: 练习讨论相关资产时，把已确认的和解款视为「基本确定的资源流入」。

examples.en: Our group asked which new evidence would support a virtually certain inflow in the unfinished claim scenario.
examples.zh: 我们组问，索赔尚未了结时，哪些新证据能支持「基本确定的资源流入」的判断。

collocations: evidence of a virtually certain inflow
account for a virtually certain inflow

words.enDefinition: The portion of a change in a total caused by a change in the amount sold, bought or produced.

examples.en: The workshop's costs rose mainly because of the volume effect after it produced an extra batch of folders.
examples.zh: 工场多做了一批文件夹，成本上涨主要来自「数量效应」。

examples.en: We held the ticket price constant while estimating the volume effect for the two rehearsal dates.
examples.zh: 为了估算两个排练日期的「数量效应」，我们把票价设为不变。

collocations: label the volume effect in a variance bridge

words.enDefinition: a provision for expected costs of a warranty that assures already sold goods meet agreed specifications, separate from revenue accounting for an additional warranty service

examples.en: The case updated the warranty provision after a new set of repair claims arrived from customers.
examples.zh: 收到顾客新提交的一批维修索赔后，例题更新了「产品保修预计负债」。

examples.en: We checked whether the warranty provision covered products the sample company had sold before year end.
examples.zh: 我们核对「产品保修预计负债」是否涵盖示例公司年末前已经售出的商品。

collocations: increase the warranty provision for expected claims

words.enDefinition: process costing that combines opening work-in-process costs with current costs when calculating equivalent-unit costs

examples.en: The worksheet used weighted-average process costing to pool the opening and current costs of materials.
examples.zh: 练习表用「加权平均分步成本法」汇总期初与当期材料成本。

examples.en: Our tutor compared weighted-average process costing with FIFO using a month with opening unfinished stock.
examples.zh: 导师用月初有未完工存货的一个月比较了「加权平均分步成本法」与先进先出法。

words.enDefinition: a reconciliation from opening to closing work-in-process inventory, showing costs added and costs transferred out

examples.en: We used the work in process rollforward to explain why unfinished orders carried a higher balance.
examples.zh: 我们通过「在产品余额变动表」解释，为什么未完工订单对应的余额更高。

examples.en: The work in process rollforward showed the costs transferred to finished goods at month end.
examples.zh: 「在产品余额变动表」列出了月末转入产成品的成本。

collocations: prepare a work in process rollforward
review the work in process rollforward
reconcile a work in process rollforward

words.enDefinition: an individual reconciliation adjustment reflecting a movement in an operating working capital account

examples.en: The only working capital adjustment in the simplified example was the increase in receivables from customers.
examples.zh: 简化示例唯一的「营运资本变动调整项」是应收顾客款的增加额。

examples.en: The student checked each working capital adjustment against the balance sheet before submitting the cash flow statement.
examples.zh: 提交现金流量表之前，学生对照资产负债表核对了每个「营运资本变动调整项」。

words.enDefinition: an increase in funds tied up in operating working capital

examples.en: The fictional shop's working capital build reflected its purchases before the annual student market.
examples.zh: 虚构商店在年度学生集市前备货，带来了「营运资金占用增加」。

examples.en: The cash bridge showed a working capital build even though the business reported higher profit.
examples.zh: 尽管企业报告的利润提高了，现金桥接表仍显示「营运资金占用增加」。

collocations: cash absorbed by a working capital build

words.enDefinition: growth compared with the corresponding period one year earlier

examples.en: The chart showed year-over-year growth by comparing this June with June of the previous year.
examples.zh: 图表通过比较今年六月与去年六月来显示「同比增长」。

examples.en: We checked whether the reported year-over-year growth covered the same number of trading weeks.
examples.zh: 我们核对了报告的「同比增长」是否取自营业周数相同的两段期间。

words.enDefinition: Recorded revenues, costs or other results from the start of the financial year through the latest reporting date.

examples.en: We compared year-to-date actuals with the budget for the same six months in the finance exercise.
examples.zh: 在财务练习中，我们把「年初至今实际数」和同一六个月的预算进行比较。

examples.en: The year-to-date actuals showed that the workshop had already used most of its annual materials allowance.
examples.zh: 「年初至今实际数」显示，工场已用掉年度材料定额的大部分。

collocations: reconcile year-to-date actuals to the ledger

words.enDefinition: A method requiring activities and expenses to be justified afresh for each budgeting cycle.

examples.en: The student print unit tried zero-based budgeting and reviewed whether it still needed every subscription.
examples.zh: 学生印刷部门尝试「零基预算编制」，重新核查每项订阅是否仍有必要。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how zero-based budgeting would change the way the workshop planned its spending.
examples.zh: 老师问，「零基预算编制」会怎样改变工场规划支出的方式。
